plugins.readme_text:
# DSH 小浣熊 Connect

[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![DSH 内核](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.1--rc.1%20~%200.2.x-2f6f4f.svg)](#安装与版本对应)
[![tests](https://img.shields.io/badge/tests-176%20passing-4b6fff.svg)](./CHANGELOG.md)
[![CI](https://github.com/zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect/actions/workflows/ci.yml)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-raccoon-connect?color=cb3837)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-raccoon-connect)

> **仓库**：[GitHub · zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect](https://github.com/zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect)
> ｜ **国内镜像**：[Gitee · dhzl/dsh-raccoon-connect](https://gitee.com/dhzl/dsh-raccoon-connect)（GitHub 访问不稳时用这个，内容同步）

把**商汤小浣熊**桌面 App 里的模型（GLM-5.3、GLM-5.3-Flash、Kimi-K3、SenseNova-6.8-Flash-Lite、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash 等）
接进 **DeepSeek Harness**，在 DSH 的对话窗口里直接选、直接用——**不用填任何 API Key**。
插件复用桌面端自己的登录态，账号切换自动跟随，模型名后面还带着上游的计费倍率与促销标签。

> ### 这是带 DSH 0.2.x 支持的 fork
>
> 上游 [liudapeng0311/dsh-raccoon-work](https://github.com/liudapeng0311/dsh-raccoon-work) 只声明支持 `0.1.5-rc.1`，
> 在 DSH 0.2.x 内核上会被兼容性校验**直接拒绝、装不上**。本 fork 把内核适配补到 0.2.x，
> 并在 Windows + Desktop profile + `0.2.1-rc.2` 上实测可用（模型分组出现、可正常对话）。
>
> **除内核适配外没有改任何东西**——上游协议、令牌语义、倍率算法、识图判定、探测逻辑一律保持原样；
> 176 个上游测试全部通过。逐条改动见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。
>
> 上游协议与实现思路另参考 [corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect](https://github.com/corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect)（MIT），
> 但上游协议、令牌语义、倍率算法与探测判定全部按小浣熊网关的**实测行为**重写，见 `docs/upstream-protocol.md`。

## 快速开始

**前置**：本机已安装并登录 [商汤小浣熊桌面端](https://xiaohuanxiong.com)。插件不启动它、也不代替它登录。

```sh
# 1) 安装插件（Desktop profile；Web 端把 desktop 换成 web）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-raccoon-connect
# 或直接从 GitHub 装：
# dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect

# 2) 完全退出 DSH（含托盘）再重新打开

# 3) 模型选择器里选「商汤小浣熊」分组的模型，开聊
```

装完**不需要再登录一次**——插件直接读桌面端写给本地 agent 的凭据文件。

## 常见问题

**桌面端要一直开着吗？**
不用。插件读的是凭据**文件**（`~/.box-agent/config/auth.json`），不是运行中的进程。只要桌面端曾经登录过、
凭据仍在有效期内，关掉 App 照样能用。只有三种情况需要打开 App：首次登录、凭据失效/被吊销、切换账号。

**支持哪些 DSH 版本？**
本 fork 支持 `0.2.1-rc.1` – `0.2.x`（实测 `0.2.1-rc.2`）。上游 0.1.x 线请用[上游仓库](https://github.com/liudapeng0311/dsh-raccoon-work)。
装错世代会被 DSH 的兼容性校验拒绝——这是保护，不是故障。

**和 `dsh-connect-sensenova-token-plan` 有什么区别？**
两者是**互不依赖**的两条通道：那条走商汤控制台的账号密码登录与网页微信扫码；本插件走**桌面端凭据**。
所以上游网页扫码页有任何变动都不影响本插件。

**会消耗我自己的积分吗？**
会——用的是你小浣熊账号自己的额度。插件只做本机转发，不代理、不上传你的数据，凭据也不出本机。
请遵守商汤小浣熊的服务条款，详见文末[免责声明](#免责声明)。

**装完看不到模型分组？**
按顺序查：① 桌面端是否登录过（`~/.box-agent/config/auth.json` 是否存在）；② DSH 是否**完全重启**过；
③ 跑 `dsh plugin --profile desktop exec dsh-raccoon-connect doctor` 看诊断。

## 功能

- **开箱即用**：安装并启用插件后，直接在 DSH 里选模型对话，不需要填任何 key。插件复用商汤小浣熊桌面端的登录状态（它自己给本地 agent 写的那个凭据文件），账号切换自动跟随。

- **倍率与促销**：模型名后面直接带上游目录里的计费倍率和促销标签，例如
  `GLM-5-3-Flash · x0.10 · 限时折扣`、`SenseNova-6.8-Flash-Lite · x0.00 · 限免一个月`。
  倍率只是显示，不影响实际请求；促销按时间窗口实时重算，过期后自动回到原价，原价也拿不到时显示「价格未知」而不是继续挂着折扣价。

- **图片输入**：能不能发图按**逐个模型的实测结果**判定，而不是照抄目录标签。上游目录里唯一的能力信号就是 `vision` 标签，而 2026-09-18 实测发现它在 5 个可见模型里错了 2 个、且两个方向都错：`DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash` 与 `GLM-5-3-Flash` 没有标签却真的能读图，`GLM-5-3` 打了标签但网关会把图片直接丢掉（模型回一句「我看不到这张图片」，比拒绝更难发现）。当前按实测声明支持识图的是 SenseNova-6.8-Flash-Lite、Kimi-K3、GLM-5-3-Flash、DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash；GLM-5-3 声明为纯文本，DSH 不会往里塞图片。上游新上的模型如果标签又标错了，用插件配置里的 `visionModelIds` / `textOnlyModelIds` 手工纠正即可，不必等发版；重跑实测见下方「真机复核」。

- **思考内容**：上游把思考放在非标准的 `delta.reasoning_content` 字段里，插件原样透传，DSH 侧照常显示 reasoning 流。

- **信息查看与刷新**：设置 → 插件 → 「商汤小浣熊」卡片显示账号、身份（个人/企业）、令牌有效期、剩余积分、当前模型列表来源（实时 / 已保存 / 内置兜底）与最近一次失败原因，也可以手动刷新模型列表。

- **推理等级探测**：卡片与输入框上都有「检测」入口，但**默认不做任何猜测**（见下文为什么它通常给出「不可校验」）。

## 安装与版本对应

前置：已安装并登录商汤小浣熊桌面端。插件不启动它、也不代替它登录。

```sh
# ① npm（推荐）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add dsh-raccoon-connect

# ② GitHub 源码（lib/ 已入库，装完即可用）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:zhlcba/dsh-raccoon-connect

# ③ 本地目录（开发用）
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/path/to/dsh-raccoon-connect
```

装完**完全退出 DSH（含托盘）再启动**，然后在模型选择器里找「商汤小浣熊」分组。

**版本对应**：插件必须与 DSH 核心的世代匹配，混用会导致 DSH 启动失败。

| 插件版本 | 要求的 DSH 核心 | Node | 实测 |
|---|---|---|---|
| `0.2.x`（本 fork） | `>=0.2.1-rc.1 <0.3` | `^22.19.0 \|\| >=24.0.0` | Windows + Desktop，`0.2.1-rc.2` ✅ |
| `0.1.x`（上游） | `0.1.5-rc.1` | 同上 | 上游只在 Web profile 验证过 |

本 fork 的实测范围：Windows、Desktop profile、DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`——插件能注册（`$DSH_HOME/.raccoon-host-heartbeat.json`）、
模型分组出现在选择器、选中模型可正常收发。设置卡片走的是运行时桥接（新内核的 slot 联合类型不含它），
卡片能否渲染未逐一验证；卡片缺席不影响模型服务。`dsh.client.platform` 仍声明为 `web`。

## 配置

插件卡片没有这些字段的编辑控件，改的是 profile 的补丁层 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`（追加一段针对 `llm-raccoon` 的 `config`，改完重启 DSH）：

```yaml
- id: llm-raccoon
  config:
    # authFile: 'C:/Users/you/.box-agent/config/auth.json'   # 默认读 ~/.box-agent/config/auth.json（别留空串，会覆盖成无效路径）
    # probeConsent: true      # 长期授权「检测推理等级」；默认关，每次检测都花少量积分
    visionModelIds: []      # 强制按「能识图」提供的模型 id
    textOnlyModelIds: []    # 强制按「纯文本」提供的模型 id，优先级高于上一行
```

`visionModelIds` / `textOnlyModelIds` 是给上游标签标错时兜底用的（见「功能」里的图片输入一节）：新模型能发图却被标成纯文本，把 id 加进前者即可，不必等插件发版；反向同理。

## 令牌是怎么复用的，以及一个必须说清的副作用

商汤小浣熊把登录态放在 `~/.box-agent/config/auth.json`（`BOX_AGENT_CONFIG_DIR` 可改位置），
访问令牌 3 小时过期，刷新令牌 30 天。它的刷新接口是**单次使用**语义：换一次令牌，新旧令牌一起轮转。

因此插件的凭据策略与只读复用不同：

- 令牌还在有效期内：直接读用，不做任何刷新，也不发网络请求。
- 令牌接近过期：插件刷新一次，并**把轮转后的新令牌写回 App 自己的 `auth.json`**。
  这是必须的——如果不写回，App 下次拿旧刷新令牌去换就会撞到 `refresh_conflict`，你会被退出登录。
  写回沿用 App 的格式与原子写方式（临时文件 + rename），并保留它原有的其他字段。
  每个进程第一次写回前，会在 `$DSH_HOME` 下留一份被替换文件的备份，作为出问题时的回滚材料。
- 撞到 `refresh_conflict`：先重读 App 文件（很可能 App 自己刚刷新过），拿到有效令牌就继续；
  拿不到才报错，并提示「打开一次商汤小浣熊重新登录」。
- 退出登录：`logout` 只删插件自留的副本和备份，**不动 App 自己的登录文件**。

没有任何登录态时，模型分组直接消失（而不是挂一串必然报错的模型）。

## 为什么「检测推理等级」多半会告诉你「不可校验」

小浣熊网关对 `reasoning_effort` 只做**部分**校验。实测（`sn-glm-5-3-flash`，最小请求）：

| 送进去的值 | 网关反应 |
|---|---|
| `off`、`banana` | 400，`该模型始终思考，不支持关闭思考；请使用 low、high 或 max。` |
| `low` / `medium` / `high` / `xhigh` / `max` | 200 |
| 随手乱写的 `randomword1234567890`、哨兵值 | **也是 200** |

也就是说「某个档位返回 200」根本证明不了它被真正执行——垃圾值同样返回 200。所以探测协议先用一个不存在的哨兵值试探网关是否真在校验；小浣熊的网关会被哨兵骗过，探测如实给出 `non-validating`，**不提供档位下拉**。这是设计上的正确结论，而不是失败：宁可没有档位控制，也不给你五个看起来能用、实际被忽略的选项。

400 报错文案里那句「请使用 low、high 或 max」确实是网关自陈的档位词表，但它是给人看的散文，不是结构化字段，插件不去解析它。

## 为什么探测要点第二次，而参考的那个插件不用

WorkBuddy 的上游在模型列表里**结构化地声明**了推理能力（`reasoning.supports` / `supportedEfforts[]` / `canDisableThinking`），插件照着填下拉就行，一次请求都不多花；探测只是它给"没声明的行"留的备用路径。小浣熊这边没有这个字段——目录行的全部字段是 `name / description / display_description / visible / model_name / tags / ability_level / params / billing_*`，没有任何一处提到档位，App 自己也从不发 `reasoning_effort`。所以档位只能实测，实测就要花积分，于是结论被缓存：按**账号 + 目录行指纹**（id、能力标签、上下文窗口、输出上限）存在 `~/.dsh/.raccoon-probe.json`，有效期 14 天，上游改了这一行就自动作废重测。

缓存要能跨重启生效才有意义。0.1.2 之前它做不到：插件启动后第一次认到账号时走的是"账号变了"这条分支，会把整个探测库清空——而那份记录恰恰就是这个账号自己花钱测的，于是每次重启都得重新点一遍检测。现在这条分支不再清空（跨账号的安全本来就由每条记录自带的账号字段把住：账号不符即视为无记录），重启后下拉直接可用。

## 命令行

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-raccoon-connect status   # 登录态、令牌有效期、剩余积分（--json 机器可读）
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-raccoon-connect doctor   # 诊断：路径、心跳、客户端标识、兜底名册
dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-raccoon-connect logout   # 只删插件自留的凭据副本与备份
```

`status` 和 `doctor` 都**不会**刷新令牌：令牌轮换有写副作用，一个用来看状态的命令不该改登录状态。

## 真机复核

App 改版后，用这两个脚本对着真实网关重跑一遍协议（会花极少积分）：

```sh
npm run build
node tools/live-check.mjs          # 目录 / 积分 / 一次最小对话
node tools/live-stream-check.mjs   # 走完整 harness 链路：pi-ai → 本地 shim → 上游，含工具调用
node tools/vision-check.mjs        # 逐模型实测识图能力（随机色块图，自校验），对的就是 MEASURED_VISION
```

`vision-check.mjs` 会打印每个可见模型的「目录标签 / 插件实测 / 本次判定」三列，判定与标签不一致的行标 `≠tag`。App 改版或上游新增模型后重跑它，把结论回填 `src/catalog.ts` 的 `MEASURED_VISION`。

实测记录与判定都写在 `docs/upstream-protocol.md`。

## 已知限制

- 依赖小浣熊客户端接口（非官方开放 API），App 升级后可能需要跟着改；`~/.box-agent/config/auth.json` 的字段名与刷新语义是最可能变的两处。
- 只在 Windows 上真机验证过。credential 路径按 `os.homedir()` + `BOX_AGENT_CONFIG_DIR` 解析，macOS/Linux 逻辑相同但未实测；若不匹配，用 `RACCOON_AUTH_FILE` 指向实际文件。
- 目录里的 `params.context_window` / `max_tokens` 是唯一依据；上游没给的模型按保守值处理，不猜大窗口。
- 个人版 `X-Org-Code` 目前留空即可；企业版未验证。

# dsh-ui-background

[![npm version](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-ui-background.svg)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-ui-background)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-ui-background.svg)](./LICENSE)
[![node](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%E2%89%A522.19-339933)](https://nodejs.org)

给 **DeepSeek Harness Web 客户端**加一层本地背景（图片 / 视频）+ 全界面毛玻璃。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

> 装完**必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建）。
> 状态：`0.8.2`，在 **DSH 0.2.0-rc.2** 上开发与验证。RC 阶段内部契约会变，升级 DSH 后请重新验收。

## 它是什么（以及为什么不卡）

毛玻璃**不靠扫描 DOM**，而是改官方主题令牌：

```js
ctx.theme.overrideTokens('dsh-ui-background', {
  '--dsw-alias-bg-base':         { light: 'rgba(255,255,255,.62)', dark: '…' },
  '--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill': { light: '…', dark: '…' },
  // 另外 3 个抬升面 / 弹层令牌
})
```

DSH 的 `body`、主框架、侧栏本来就用这些令牌画背景，所以：

- 零 DOM 扫描、零 `MutationObserver`、零逐面板 `backdrop-filter`
- 关掉 = 撤销令牌层，界面**立刻回到出厂样式**，无残留
- 背景层是**一个** `position:fixed; z-index:-1` 的图层（图片走纯 CSS，视频走一个 `<video>`）

## 功能

- 背景来源：上传文件 / 本机路径（只读，不复制不移动）
- 视频背景：`mp4` / `webm` 循环播放，切到后台自动暂停
- 构图：`铺满(cover)` / `完整(contain)`、缩放 50–300%、水平/垂直位置，**预览里可直接拖动**
- 壁纸引擎：自动扫 Steam 工坊 `431960`，**只列出可直接播放的**（视频/图片）
- 最近使用：最多 12 条，带缩略图与**构图参数**，一键切回，可单条删除
- 上传文件可单个删除；删到正在用的那张会自动关掉背景
- 全部本地：不联网、不收集数据

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-ui-background
```

**装完必须重启一次 Host**（DSH 的模块解析表在启动时构建，新装的包当次不可导入）。

重启后：设置 → **背景与玻璃**。

## 适合什么场景

- 用本地图片或视频当背景，界面跟着半透明
- 换图之后不用重新调构图：每条历史记录里都存着缩放与位置

做不到的：Wallpaper Engine 的 Scene 渲染。`scene.pkg` 需要它自己的引擎，本插件只读图片和视频文件。
## 已知限制

| 限制 | 原因 |
|---|---|
| Scene 壁纸不能当背景 | `scene.pkg` 是 Wallpaper Engine 私有格式，需要它的引擎渲染；包里没有现成图片 |
| 别拿 WE 预览图凑数 | 实测预览图只有 **144–254 px**，铺满 1920 宽会糊 7–13 倍 |
| 想要 WE 画面 → 截图 | 开着 WE，`Win+Shift+S` 截屏后点「粘贴截图」（1920×1080，清晰） |
| `mkv` / `mov` 可能不播 | Edge 不支持这些容器，用 `mp4` / `webm` |
| 半透明会影响所有用基础背景令牌的地方 | 代码块顶栏、图片占位、弹层遮罩都会跟着透明，这是同一套令牌的代价 |

## 安全

- Host 端只读**你在设置里显式填写的**那一个本机文件，以及 Steam 工坊目录里的 `project.json` / 媒体 / 预览图
- HTTP 路由仅回环；写操作拒绝 `sec-fetch-site: cross-site`
- 上传目录内的文件名已净化，不接受路径穿越
- 状态存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages/dsh-ui-background/`（`state.json` + `backgrounds/`），卸载插件**不会**自动删除，请自行清理

## 开发

```bash
node selftest.mjs   # 用假 Cordis 上下文挂载 host 半身，直接打自己的 HTTP 处理器
```

`lib` 端只依赖 `node:fs` / `node:path` / `node:os`，没有 npm 运行时依赖。

MIT

# dsh-approval-latency

把「这次工具调用在等人类点审批」这件事**回传给模型**：

> 一次调用卡在审批上等了 6 分 42 秒才被放行时，模型在下一轮会收到一条上下文消息，
> 说明那段空档是**人的响应延迟**，不是工具报错、不是超时、也不是它上一轮的代码有问题——
> 因此不必因为「时间过了很久」去重新排查已经正确的东西。

[English](README.en.md) · MIT · 纯 host 侧，无网络、无文件访问、不改任何审批结果 ·
仓库 <https://github.com/UPxianyu/dsh-approval-latency>

---

## 1. 它解决什么问题

DSH 的运行时上下文里有一行：

```markdown
Elapsed since the preceding model-visible message: 6m 42s
```

（来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-time-context`。）它算的是**墙上时间**，但模型看到的只有两个数字：
「上一条消息」和「现在」。审批是唯一会让这个数字突然变大的日常路径——你去开会、去倒水、
去回别人消息，回来才点了「允许一次」。

于是模型面对的是这样的推理岔路：

| 模型看到的 | 常见的错误结论 |
|---|---|
| 工具结果正常返回，但中间空了 7 分钟 | 「刚才那条命令是不是卡住了 / 环境不稳定」 |
| 工具被拒绝，而拒绝出现在 9 分钟后 | 「我的改法不对，用户否掉了，我重写一版」 |
| 两个文件都改完，但两步之间各空了几分钟 | 「前面那些改动可能没生效，重新验证一遍」 |

这三条都会烧掉注意力，而且都建立在**一个并不存在的因果**上：时间 ≠ 结果。
审批的等待时间属于「人」这一侧，跟工具、代码、参数、沙箱都没有关系。

本插件把那句话补上：等待超过阈值时，在**该步骤的工具结果之后**追加一条上下文消息，
明确说清「这段空档是审批等待」。模型不需要猜，也不需要再从时间戳反推。

## 2. 行为

「太长」不是常量，是**先量出来的**：门槛默认由本机最近回答过的审批耗时决定（见第 4 节）。
下表的「门槛」指生效的那个数，不是写死的 30 秒。

| 情形 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 调用需要审批，等待 ≥ **通过门槛**，最终**通过** | 追加一条提示：等了多久、是人的响应时间、不要因此重开前面的工作 |
| 等待 ≥ **拒绝门槛**（默认是通过门槛的一半），最终**被拒绝** | 追加一条提示：等了多久、这么久之后的「否」可能是过期/误触，若与用户要求不符应先问再改 |
| 等待 ≥ 通过门槛，最终**取消 / 无人应答** | 追加一条提示：这一枪没打响，空档不代表调用或代码有问题 |
| 等待 < 对应门槛 | 什么都不加（正常人点审批的速度不该产生噪音） |
| 该调用**没有**经过审批 | 什么都不加 |
| `reportDenials: false` | 只回报「通过」的等待，拒绝/取消的不回报 |

提示不会改写工具结果本身（审计里 `tool/result` 仍是工具自己的输出），而是作为一条
`notice` 形式的用户消息，紧随本步骤的工具结果进入下一轮请求。

### 2.1 适用场景

**值得开的四种情形**

1. **你离开电脑，审批挂了很久**（本插件实测过 **9 分 8 秒**）。模型拿到的是「工具结果 + 这段是人在点审批」，
   而不是一个来历不明、还特别慢的结果。
2. **长跑 / 无人值守的 Agent**：你在别的窗口干活，审批弹出来半天才看见。
3. **耗时的那次结果又不理想**：没有时间归因时，模型很容易把「久」和「错」连起来，开始怀疑自己前面做过的事。
4. **你确实会拒绝的场合**：拒绝几乎总是发生在你回来之后，模型很容易理解成「我的方案被否了」，
   而实际可能只是回答一个已经过期的提示。

**不需要它的情形**

1. **你总是秒批**：本机实测审批中位数 **4.6 秒**，默认档几乎不会触发（见 2.2 的统计）。
2. **没有审批的操作**（读文件、写工作区内文件）——完全不触发。
3. **想解释「非审批」造成的耗时**（你打断后去处理别的事、机器休眠、模型排队、网络慢）——不在语义内。
4. **`never` 策略**（审批被确定性拒绝）——没有等待，也就没有通知。

### 2.2 一次真实的 9 分 8 秒（实测记录）

2026-10-18 的实测：把一次 `pwsh` 调用挂起 **9 分 8 秒**后才批准。模型在这一步实际收到的两条信息：

```text
[tool/result]  marker read back: Synthetic approval test at 2026-10-18T14:30:34+08:00
               directory removed again: True

[user/message, source.kind = approval-latency]
Approval wait: "pwsh" ran 9m 8s after the user approved it — human latency, not a tool failure,
and not evidence about earlier work. Judge only this result.
```

**同一时刻**，运行时上下文里的耗时行是这个：

```text
Elapsed since the preceding step context: unavailable.
```

也就是：**没有这条通知，模型完全不知道中间过了 9 分钟。** 这不是个例——从本机 6 个会话日志、
32 次审批里统计，工具步骤之后（step ≥ 2）的 elapsed **全部是 `unavailable`**，
带数字的只出现在两条用户消息之间。所以在这台机器上，这条通知是**唯一的时间归因来源**，
成本 156 字符 ≈ **41 token**。

它也确实进了会话日志，能回放：

```text
seq 3217  user/message  source = {"kind":"approval-latency","form":"notice",
                                  "summary":"approval wait 9m 8s before pwsh ran"}
```

另一类更早的真实事故没有日志可查：跑 ComfyUI 出图时模型思考跑偏，只能强行终止。
当时既没有时间线索、也没有「这个否可能是过期的」语义，模型只能自己编原因——这正是本插件要堵的洞。

### 2.3 模型实际读到的文本（三种变体）

每条都是**一行、三件事**：等了多久 → 这是人的延迟而不是失败/代码问题 → 只判这次结果。
解释性从句全部砍掉：一段「关于时间的说明」本身就在邀请模型讨论时间，而这正是要避免的跑偏，还白付一倍 token。

通过（154 字符 ≈ **41 token**）：

```markdown
Approval wait: "bash" ran 2m 8s after the user approved it — human latency, not a tool failure,
and not evidence about earlier work. Judge only this result.
```

拒绝（154 字符 ≈ 41 token；注意这里没有「先去问用户」，只陈述事实）：

```markdown
Approval wait: the user rejected "write" after 4m 10s. A "no" that late may be stale rather than
a verdict on your approach — check it against what was asked.
```

取消 / 无人应答（127 / 116 字符 ≈ 33 / 31 token）：

```markdown
Approval wait: "pwsh" stayed unapproved for 1m 0s and was cancelled, so it never ran.
Human latency, not evidence about the code.
```

> 长度预算是硬约束：`test/latency.test.mjs` 断言四种变体分别不超过 200 / 200 / 170 / 170 字符，
> 且不超过 3 句、必须以 `Approval wait: ` 开头——防止以后越写越长。
answer, so the call never ran. That gap is human or scheduling latency — not evidence about
the call or the code it touches.
```

## 3. 安装

在 DSH 里（profile 名换成你自己的，桌面版默认 `desktop`）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add /path/to/dsh-approval-latency
```

或从仓库：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:UPxianyu/dsh-approval-latency
```

装完重启 `dsh web`（或桌面版），插件随 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 插入
`approval-latency` 这一行即可生效。

卸载：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-approval-latency
```

### 3.1 在插件页里改（推荐）

插件管理**不在设置对话框里**，它是主界面左侧「全局面板图标」里的一个面板（图标是风车，tooltip「插件」；
设置里的「内置插件」是只读清单）。路径：

**左侧风车图标「插件」→「已安装」→ `dsh-approval-latency` 卡片 → 点带 `›` 的那一行标题
（显示为 `审批等待回传（Approval Wait Notice） ›`，它的无障碍名就是「配置 审批等待回传（Approval Wait Notice）」）**

那一行标题之所以是可点的按钮（带 `›`），正是因为本插件为这一行注册了配置页；
没有注册页的行只是纯文本、没有箭头。

| 控件 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| **自适应** 开关 | 开（默认）：门槛跟着你回答审批的速度走（见 4.2）。关：用下面的固定时长。 |
| **固定时长** 输入框 | 秒数，默认 **30**。回车或失焦才写入；填 0 / 非数字会被拦下并提示，不会写进配置。 |
| **恢复默认** | 清掉本页写入的覆盖，回落到本 bundle 的默认值（30 秒 / 自适应）。 |

写进去的值由 Host 落到 profile 的 Cordis patch（与手改 YAML 同一层），**不需要重启**：
这些字段是 `volatile` 的，改完从下一次审批开始生效。页面上的「已覆盖」徽标表示这一项有页面写入。

页面上看不到「当前学到的基线是多少」——那是宿主内存里的数，只写进 debug 日志；
页面只负责改配置（延迟、体积、侵入性都最小的那一半）。

## 4. 阈值怎么配

这一节是同一份配置的 **YAML 写法**（适合脚本化、团队统一、CI）。两种模式都能在设置页里切换（见 3.1），
定义与算法完全相同。

改配置就在 **profile** 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里用同 id 覆盖（同 id 覆盖会**整块替换**
`config`，所以只写你要改的字段，其余回落到默认值）：

| 你写的 | 生效 |
|---|---|
| 什么都不写 | `mode: auto`（自适应） |
| `mode: auto` | 自适应，用本机速度；`fixedMs` 不参与 |
| `mode: fixed` | 固定 `fixedMs`，默认 **30000（30 秒）** |
| 只写 `fixedMs: 45000` | 自动当成 `mode: fixed`（填了数，数字就该生效） |
| 只写 `thresholdMs: 45000`（0.2.0 的旧写法） | 同上，按别名处理，仍然可用 |

`mode` 显式写了就听它的：`mode: auto` 同时给 `fixedMs` 不算冲突，只是那个数用不上
（和 `mode: fixed` 下 `floorMs` 用不上是一个道理）。

### 4.1 固定时长（最省事的两种写法）

```yaml
# profile/cordis.patch.yml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: fixed          # 不写 fixedMs 就用默认 30000 = 30 秒
```

```yaml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: fixed
    fixedMs: 45000       # 45 秒
```

**默认为什么是 30 秒**：低于 30 秒基本还是正常点击速度，提醒只会变成噪音；到 30 秒以上，
模型那行 `Elapsed since the preceding model-visible message` 已经大到足以让它怀疑自己，
这时一条「这是审批延迟」最值钱。宁可少提醒，也别让提醒变成背景音。

### 4.2 自适应（默认）怎么算

```
通过门槛 = clamp( multiplier × median(最近 20 次真实回答的耗时), floorMs, ceilingMs )
```

- **样本**：只收「真的回答了」的审批——`allowed-once` 与 `rejected`。取消、无人应答不算，
  因为它们不代表你回答得慢。
- **每条样本先夹到 `ceilingMs`**：一次出门三小时不会把基线拽走。
- **用中位数而不是均值**：偶发的长等待不会移动它。
- **样本不足 `minSamples`（默认 3）时用 30 秒冷启动值**——`30s` 只是「还没有数据时」的占位，
  不是永恒的门槛。
- **正在被判断的这次等待不进样本**：先用历史算门槛、再记账，所以一次超长等待不能自己给自己发通行证。
- `floorMs`（默认 10s）保证再灵敏也不会为「点得挺快」打扰；`ceilingMs`（默认 5min）
  保证基线不会漂到永远不触发。

举例：你平时 4 秒点掉审批 → 门槛 12 秒；某天你一直 90 秒才点 → 门槛自动抬到 5 分钟（上限）。
换台机器、换个人，就是另一套数——因为这个数字本来就该是「对谁而言」。

### 4.3 按结果分流（两种模式都生效）

```
拒绝门槛 = clamp( 通过门槛 × rejectionScale, min(floorMs, 通过门槛), 通过门槛 )
```

迟到的「否」是最贵的误解（模型会去重写代码），所以默认用一半的门槛先提醒一次；
设 `rejectionScale: 1` 就与通过同门槛。取消 / 无人应答仍用通过门槛，因为那本来就不是一次判断。

### 4.4 开关

`reportDenials: false` 只回传通过的等待。

### 4.5 全部字段

本 bundle 的 patch 已写入全部默认值：

```yaml
- id: approval-latency
  name: dsh-approval-latency
  config:
    mode: auto             # auto = 自适应；fixed = 固定 fixedMs
    fixedMs: 30000         # fixed 模式的固定时长（毫秒）；不写 mode 时填了它即按 fixed
    floorMs: 10000         # auto：门槛下限
    ceilingMs: 300000      # auto：门槛上限，也是单条样本的截断值
    multiplier: 3          # auto：几倍本机中位数算「异常长」
    minSamples: 3          # auto：攒够几条真实回答才从冷启动切到学习值
    rejectionScale: 0.5    # 拒绝门槛 = 通过门槛 × 该系数，范围 (0, 1]
    reportDenials: true    # 是否也回传拒绝 / 取消 / 无人应答
```

| 字段 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `mode` | `auto` | `auto` 学习本机速度；`fixed` 永远用 `fixedMs`。 |
| `fixedMs` | `30000` | 固定模式的门槛（毫秒）。`0` 表示每次审批都回传（调试用）。 |
| `floorMs` | `10000` | 自适应门槛下限：低于它的等待永不打扰。 |
| `ceilingMs` | `300000` | 自适应门槛上限，同时截断单条样本。 |
| `multiplier` | `3` | 「异常长」= 多少倍本机中位数。越小越敏感。 |
| `minSamples` | `3` | 攒够多少条真实回答才从冷启动切到学习值。 |
| `rejectionScale` | `0.5` | 拒绝门槛 = 通过门槛 × 该系数，范围 (0, 1]。 |
| `reportDenials` | `true` | 是否也回传「等到最后被拒绝 / 取消 / 无人应答」。 |
| `thresholdMs` | — | **已弃用**：`fixedMs` 的别名，写了即等于 `mode: fixed`。 |

### 4.6 常见调法

| 想要 | 改什么 |
|---|---|
| 稳定可预测，不看历史 | `mode: fixed`（默认 30 秒）或 `mode: fixed` + `fixedMs` |
| 更敏感（离开 10 秒就提醒） | `floorMs: 5000`、`multiplier: 2` |
| 更安静（只在明显离开时提醒） | `multiplier: 5`、`ceilingMs: 600000` |
| 只拦「真的离开了」 | `mode: fixed` + `fixedMs: 120000`（2 分钟） |
| 拒绝别那么吵 | `rejectionScale: 1` 或 `reportDenials: false` |
| 刚装上看效果 | `mode:

plugins.description: DSH 插件：Skill 与 MCP 使用审计。扫描 20 类 skill 来源，标注每个 skill 来自哪个工具，在对话顶部状态栏显示真实调用次数、成败、耗时与 MCP 使用。
plugins.readme_text:
# skill-use — Skill 与 MCP 使用审计

[![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-plugin-3ecf8e)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue)](LICENSE)
[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@yizitiguan/skill-use)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@yizitiguan/skill-use)

DSH 插件。回答三个原生 UI 回答不了的问题：

1. **我到底装了多少 skill？它们来自哪个工具？**
2. **这次任务真正调用了哪些 skill，成功还是失败？**
3. **MCP 有哪些 server / 工具，被调用了多少次？**

入口在**对话顶部状态栏**（与子智能体、团队看板、任务列表同一排），
点击展开面板。

---

## 安装

要求 DSH `>= 0.1.5-rc.1`。本插件**无构建步骤**，纯 ESM + 浏览器端纯 JS，
克隆下来即可用。

### 方式一：npm（最快）

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add @yizitiguan/skill-use
```

### 方式二：从 GitHub 本地链接

克隆后用 `link:` 方式装进 profile：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yizitiguan/skill-use.git
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add link:<克隆下来的绝对路径>
```

或者在 DSH 里用插件管理器：

```
plugin_manager install_bundle <克隆下来的 skill-use 目录绝对路径>
```

### 方式三：手动写进 profile

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml
- insert:
    - id: skill-use
      name: '@yizitiguan/skill-use'
```

同时确保包已在 profile 的 `node_modules` 里（`pnpm add link:<目录>` 或从 npm 装）。

安装完成后**刷新页面**，顶部状态栏会出现 `Skill · 已用/已发现` 按钮。

> ⚠ 开发注意：`lib/client.js` 里 `__ModuleLoader__.load({ id })` 的 `id`
> **必须等于 package.json 的包名**。装载器按包名分配模块 id，不一致会导致
> factory 注册不上 —— 表现为插槽 `active: true` 但界面完全不渲染。
> 插槽注册用的 `id: 'skill-use'` 是另一个东西（cell key），不受此约束。

---

## 面板内容

```
┌─ Skill 使用 ─────────────────────────────── ✕ ┐
│ SKILL 使用                      1 次 · 1 个   │
│  ● cordis-plugin-development  [内置]  ×1 成功  │
│                          ▓▓▓▓▓▓▓▓  4ms        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 来源分布                      1 个来源         │
│  ● Agent  [DSH 加载]  45 个 · 已用 0  ▓▓▓▓▓▓  │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ MCP 使用                                       │
│  当前 profile 未配置 MCP server。配置后会显示    │
│  调用次数、方法与成功率。                        │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ ▸ 未使用的 Skill 45 · 禁用 1                   │
├───────────────────────────────────────────────┤
│ 发现 45 个  已用 1 个  调用 1 次                │
└───────────────────────────────────────────────┘
```

| 区块 | 内容 |
|---|---|
| Skill 使用 | 每个被调用 skill 的次数、成败、平均耗时、来源标签 |
| 来源分布 | 按工具来源统计数量与使用情况，标出 DSH 会加载的来源 |
| **MCP 使用** | MCP server 调用次数、方法明细、已注册 MCP 工具 |
| 未使用的 Skill | 可折叠；标出被 skills-manager 禁用的项 |
| 统计窗口 | 事件数与时间跨度 |

每个 skill 带**来源标签**：
- `[Claude Code]` / `[Agent]` / … → 磁盘上的来源目录
- `[内置]` → 磁盘上找不到，说明是插件 / preset 自带 skill

---

## MCP 是怎么识别的

DSH 里 MCP 工具**没有统一前缀**，所以分三层识别（`lib/state.js` 的 `classifyMcp`）：

1. **内置资源工具**（精确集合，来自 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-resources`）：
   `list_mcp_resources`、`list_mcp_resource_templates`、`read_mcp_resource`
   —— 参数带 `server` 字段，可精确归因
2. **约定前缀**：`mcp__<server>__<tool>` 或 `mcp_<server>_<tool>`
3. **注册表匹配**：`ctx.tools.schemas()` 里识别出的 MCP 工具名

server 名优先取调用参数里的 `server`，否则取工具名前缀。
调用了但注册表里没有的 server 会进 `stale`，便于排查已卸载的配置。

> ⚠ **本机的实际状态是没有配置任何 MCP server**，所以面板显示
> 「当前 profile 未配置 MCP server」。这是如实反映，不是渲染失败。
> 统计链路（`auditUsage` 的 MCP 分支）已实现，配置 server 后自动生效，
> 但**这条路径未在真实 MCP server 上验证过**。

---

## 为什么要扫盘

DSH 原生 `ctx.skills.list()` 只报当前 session 可见的 skill —— 本机上只有 **8 个**。

而用户实际安装了 **45 个**，全在 `~/.agents/skills/` 里。
各家 AI 编码工具（Claude Code、Codex、Cursor、Qoder、Trae、Lingma…）
都把 skills 放在自己的配置目录下，格式统一为：

```
<tool-home>/skills/<skill-name>/SKILL.md   ← 带 YAML frontmatter
```

所以本插件**直接扫盘**，而不是依赖原生服务。

### 支持的来源（20 类）

与 [`@michengai/dsh-skills-manager`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager)
的 `EXTERNAL_SOURCE_ORDER` 对齐：

| 来源 | 路径 | DSH 加载 |
|---|---|---|
| DSH | `~/.dsh/skills` | ✅ |
| Agent | `~/.agents/skills` | ✅ |
| Codex | `~/.codex/skills` | |
| Claude Code | `~/.claude/skills` | |
| Gemini | `~/.gemini/skills` | |
| OpenCode | `~/.config/opencode/skills` | |
| Cursor | `~/.cursor/skills` | |
| Copilot | `~/.copilot/skills` | |
| Windsurf | `~/.codeium/windsurf/skills` | |
| Windsurf (user) | `~/.windsurf/skills` | |
| Trae / Trae CN | `~/.trae/skills`、`~/.trae-cn/skills` | |
| OpenClaw | `~/.openclaw/skills` | |
| ClawdBot | `~/.clawdbot/skills` | |
| Roo | `~/.roo/skills` | |
| CodeBuddy | `~/.codebuddy/skills` | |
| WorkBuddy | `~/.workbuddy/skills` | |
| Qoder / Qoder CN | `~/.qoder/skills`、`~/.qoder-cn/skills` | |
| Lingma | `~/.lingma/skills` | |

每类都支持环境变量覆盖（如 `DSH_CLAUDE_HOME`），与 skills-manager 约定一致。

---

## 数据怎么来的

### 调用统计

```
tool/call    name=skill  args={"name":"cordis-plugin-development"}
tool/result  message.toolCallId → 配对回该次调用，读 error / isError
```

- 调用次数、成功 / 失败、本轮平均耗时
- 失败时记录 `error.reason`
- 用 `tool/call` 的参数名去来源索引里查，得到**来源归因**

### 来源归因

1. 扫盘得到 `name → { source, sourceLabel }` 索引
2. 同名 skill 出现在多个来源时，优先取 `native`（DSH 实际会加载的那个）
3. 查不到 → 标记为 `builtin`（插件 / preset 内置）

---

## 主题与美化

面板只使用 `--dsw-*` 令牌上色。这是 DSH 给插件作者的规范，
也是 [dsh-wallpaper-engine](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine)
**自动把玻璃质感传给第三方插件**的机制：

> 它自己的 `docs/COEXISTENCE.md` 写明：「按宿主规范上色的第三方插件会**继承**我们的玻璃 ——
> DSH 给插件作者的规范是用 `--dsw-alias-*` 设计令牌上色，而这些令牌在玻璃生效时
> 被改写成玻璃配方 ⇒ 任何按规范写的插件都会自动带上玻璃质感。」

所以正确做法是**只消费令牌、不自己造模糊**。用到的令牌：

```
--dsw-alias-bg-base / bg-layer-1 / bg-layer-2 / bg-layer-3 / bg-overlay
--dsw-alias-border-l1 / border-l2
--dsw-alias-label-primary / label-secondary / label-tertiary
--dsw-alias-brand-primary
--dsw-alias-state-success-primary / state-error-primary / state-idle-primary
--dsw-specific-sidebar-fill
```

### 玻璃配方：复刻 wallpaper-engine 的「可读性地板 + 玻璃色」

菜单的底色**不是自己调出来的不透明度**，而是直接搬它的公式
（`src/styles-base.js` 里所有玻璃表面都用这一条）：

```css
color-mix(in srgb,
  var(--we-readability-base) calc(var(--we-readability-floor) * 100%),
  color-mix(in srgb,
    var(--we-surface-tint-light) calc(var(--we-glass-alpha) * 100%),
    transparent))
```

原理是**两层叠加**：

| 层 | 作用 | 取值 |
|---|---|---|
| 地板 `--we-readability-floor` | 不透明底，保证文字任何情况下可读 | 浅色 0.45 / 深色 0.59 |
| 釉色 `--we-glass-alpha` | 按透明度叠一层玻璃色，提供通透感 | 0.10 – 0.25 |

为什么必须有地板：只调 alpha 不够。深色主题下釉色是**白色**，
叠在最亮的壁纸像素上会让白字对比度掉到 1.00:1，彻底看不见。
地板权重固定、任何滑杆都压不低，所以 `有效覆盖 = 地板 + a·(1−地板) ≥ 地板`。

本插件消费这四个变量（`--we-readability-base` / `--we-readability-floor` /
`--we-surface-tint-light|dark` / `--we-glass-alpha`），**存在就用宿主的值**，
不存在就用同公式的兜底值。所以在设置里拉动「玻璃透明度」时，
这个菜单会跟着一起变，而不是各调各的。

### 四个必须避开的坑

**1. 弹层必须 `createPortal` 到 `document.body`。**
官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-jobs`（就是「1 个后台任务」那个下拉框）
就是这么做的。header 的祖先链上有 `backdrop-filter`，它会让
`position: fixed` 后代**以它为包含块** —— 弹层被压在 header 尺寸里，
宽度撑不开、内容竖排换行。

**2. 菜单自己加 `backdrop-filter` 是安全的。**
坑 1 说的是**祖先**加模糊会劫持后代的包含块；菜单本身是最外层
`fixed` 元素、没有后代要定位，自己加 blur 不产生这个问题。

**3. 底色不能用 `--dsw-alias-bg-base` 或 `bg-layer-1`。**
- `bg-base` 在壁纸开启时被设成 `transparent`（它要让壁纸透出来）
- `bg-layer-1` 在玻璃配方下是半透明 `color-mix`

它们单独或叠加都挡不住底层文字 —— 这就是「完全透明、字叠字」的成因。

**4. 数值要跟宿主同源，不要自己拍。**
曾经的 `rgba(30,30,36,.94)` 是 94% 不透明，把模糊整个盖死，
观感是**一块死灰板**。仿官方视觉必须仿**配方**，不是仿一个看着像的颜色。

### 令牌名必须真实存在

早期版本用了 `--dsw-alias-bg-elevated`、`--dsw-alias-text-primary` 这类
**不存在的名字**，`var()` 全部落到兜底值 ⇒ 面板不跟随主题。
真实清单见 [`TOKEN-CONTRACT.md`](https://github.com/elysia395/dsh-wallpaper-engine/blob/main/docs/TOKEN-CONTRACT.md)
（自动生成、有守卫对账）。注意 `Theme.listTokens` 只暴露 14 个常用令牌，
而实际契约里共有 **59 个**。

---

## 设置

**设置 → Skill 使用**：

| 项 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 刷新间隔 | 1.5 / 2 / 5 / 10 秒 |
| 汇总 / Skill 使用 / 未使用 / 来源分布 / 统计窗口 | 逐区块开关，立即生效 |

也可以改 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: skill-use
  config:
    refreshMs: 2000
    sections:
      usage: true
      idle: true
      sources: true
```

---

## 接口

| 方法 | 路径 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| GET | `/api/skill-use/snapshot?session=<id>` | 审计快照 |
| GET | `/api/skill-use/settings` | 读配置 |
| POST | `/api/skill-use/settings` | 写配置（局部合并） |

---

## 已验证（真实数据）

```json
{
  "skillCalls": 1,
  "skillsUsed": 1,
  "skillsDiscovered": 45,
  "skillsVisible": 8,
  "sourcesWithSkills": 1,
  "builtinUsed": 1,
  "skillsDisabled": 1,
  "managerInstalled": true
}
```

来源分布：`Agent`（`~/.agents/skills`）45 个、`native: true`、禁用 1 个。

使用明细：`cordis-plugin-development` ×1、成功、**内置**。
（DSH 原生服务只看到 8 个，这个不在其中——印证了扫盘的必要性。）

被禁用项：`ask-matt` —— 来自读取 skills-manager 的 `state.json`，
不是猜的。

---

## 与 skills-manager 的分工

读了 [`@michengai/dsh-skills-manager`](https://github.com/MichengAI/dsh-skills-manager)
的源码，它负责**管理**（安装 / 启用 / 禁用 / 分类），状态存在
`~/.dsh/skills-manager/state.j

plugins.description: Model-selectable subagents with per-task reasoning effort for DeepSeek Harness (DSH) 0.2.x. Maintained continuation of CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router.
plugins.readme_text:
# DSH Subagent Model Router

**Give every delegated task the right model and reasoning effort—automatically.**

> [!NOTE]
> This is the maintained continuation of [CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router), including [poka-IT's DSH 0.1.7/0.2.0 port](https://github.com/CypherNaught-0x/DSH-Subagent-Model-Router/pull/3). It targets DeepSeek Harness 0.2.x and adds per-task reasoning effort. Full history and credit are preserved.

Stop using one model for every kind of work. Configure your preferred fast, affordable, specialized, and high-reasoning models once; the router gives your agent the aliases, tags, and guidance it needs to intelligently select the best route for each delegated task.

That means faster routine work, stronger results on difficult problems, better control over cost, and less model micromanagement. Subagents can run in parallel, their results are reliably joined before the parent responds, and the model chosen for each task stays visible throughout the UI.

## Why use it?

- **Better results where they matter** — reserve your strongest models for architecture, security, deep reasoning, or critical review.
- **Lower cost and latency** — send routine searches, edits, and focused implementation work to faster or more economical routes.
- **Automatic, task-aware routing** — friendly aliases, capability tags, and plain-language usage guidance help the orchestrator choose intelligently.
- **Per-task reasoning effort** — the orchestrator can run the same route at `low` for mechanical work or `xhigh` for a stubborn bug, with an optional default per alias.
- **Confident parallel delegation** — launch multiple specialists in the background and reliably collect every result before synthesis.
- **Clear model visibility** — see which model actually handled a task in subagent headers and in the optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab.
- **Easy setup** — configure your model team from the Web UI, through a guided skill, or directly in a Cordis patch.

> [!TIP]
> Already using [Better Sidebar](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/DSH-better-sidebar)? The router adds an optional **Sub-agents** tab through Better Sidebar's public `registerTab` API.

## See it in action

### Follow every specialist from Better Sidebar

![Better Sidebar Tasks view showing delegated subagents and their selected model chips](docs/screenshots/better-sidebar-task-model-chips.png)

*See parallel delegated work, current status, and the selected model together in the task tree you already use.*

### Build your ideal model team

![Subagent Model Router settings for aliases, providers, tags, token limits, and routing guidance](docs/screenshots/subagent-model-router-settings.png)

*Define friendly routes and tell the orchestrator when each model shines—from quick, budget-friendly tasks to your most demanding work.*

## What it adds

- `subagent_model`: a delegation tool whose `model` argument is restricted to user-configured aliases, with an optional `reasoning_effort`.
- `wait-for-subagents`: a join tool that waits for this agent's outstanding continuable background children, including standard and model-routed delegations, and returns their terminal results.
- Per-model tags and routing descriptions embedded in the tool schema and system prompt.
- `model_subagent_catalog`: a read-only view of models advertised by registered LLM providers.
- `configure_subagent_models`: a model-facing tool that reads or replaces only this plugin entry's configuration, without filesystem access.
- `model-subagent-setup`: a guided skill for selecting routes, generating routing guidance, obtaining confirmation, and saving through the constrained configuration tool.
- **Settings → Subagent Models**: a Web settings page for manually adding, editing, and removing routes.
- A hot-reloaded plugin configuration: the `config:` of the `- id: dsh-subagent-model-router` Loader entry in a Cordis patch.
- Foreground execution and durable continuable background subagents.
- Configurable stale-subagent filtering for listing tools, defaulting to 20 parent/user message turns without contact.
- An active-model chip in an opened subagent header.
- An optional Better Sidebar **Sub-agents** tab, with active-model chips on its rows, registered through the public sidebar service (when installed).

With an empty `models` list, the catalog, configuration, and wait tools remain available alongside the settings page and setup skill, but `subagent_model` is not registered. This provides a bootstrap state for initial setup.

## Orchestrator behavior

When model-selectable delegation is available, the system prompt tells the orchestrator not to duplicate work it delegated. After issuing all intended background delegations, it must call `wait-for-subagents` before synthesizing the child results or giving a final answer. While a same-session completion goal is active, the orchestrator must not merely report that another model is handling the task and end its turn with background subagents still outstanding: ending the turn triggers immediate goal continuation and can race child tracking. Waiting joins the outstanding work so the orchestrator can synthesize the results and continue or complete the goal. The wait tool joins every continuable background child started by that parent through `subagent`, `subagent_fork`, `subagent_model`, or `auto_agent_run`; it remains useful when no model routes are configured. It reserves standard, forked, and project-specialist delegation calls before they can publish a child, and after plugin reload it discovers direct continuable children when their durable descriptors confirm their mode and the live Agent is either running or interrupted with parked input (reported separately as paused). It preserves every terminal content block and drops retained records when the parent is disposed, while foreground one-shot runs and job-backed non-continuable delegations remain outside this join because their owning tool already returns or collects the result.

Direct human steering must not leave the parent blocked in an old join. When a committed `agent/inbox/spliced` event inserts a `source.kind: user` message at `next-step` for that parent, an active wait returns `{ kind: "interrupted", pending: [...] }` without cancelling or consuming any child. Each pending entry carries the exact child and run identity when available. The DSH agent loop does not automatically schedule a second tool call after the parent answers. Instead, the plugin's system prompt, tool description, and interruption result explicitly require the parent to answer the steering message first and then call `wait-for-subagents` again before final synthesis. That second call resumes the retained records and returns their eventual terminal output; queued `next-turn` input, model-authored context, cancellations, and events for other sessions do not trigger this outcome. A simultaneous child completion remains retained for the resumed wait.

The continuation manager's durable settlement notice triggers immediate reconciliation when a terminal lifecycle event was missed. Recovery requires matching post-boundary evidence in both the retained child epoch log and the parent notice, so an absent registry entry or an idle/resumable child is never treated as success by itself. For an ordinary tracked start, the record remains bound to the exact child and run identity. After plugin reload, a genuinely running child can instead be discovered without a published run id; its exact retained Agent object plus child and parent log boundaries identify that observed activation safely. A ten-second watchdog provides the same reconciliation as a fallback if the live notice event was also missed. Cancellation still rejects the active tool call without consuming records, and parent disposal still releases tracked children and active waits. If another plugin already owns or scope-shadows the `wait-for-subagents` name, this plugin leaves it untouched and suppresses its wait-specific guidance and tracking for the affected agents.

plugins.readme_text:
在一个侧栏里读完 Git 的分支、工作树和改动。
只读查看：不 checkout、不切目录、不提交。

## 面板

- **顶部 · 当前工作树**：路径、分支（detached 时显示 `detached @ `）、`↑ahead ↓behind`、`clean / dirty / conflict`，以及 `本地分支 · 远程分支 · Worktree` 计数。 - **中部 · 分支拓扑**：主干永远是一条直线，分支向右生长，合并收回主干；点一条线高亮整条路径。 - **底部 · 详情与列表**：点提交 / 分支 / 工作树看详情；其余工作树、CHANGES、FILES 都在这里，文件行可直接点开预览。 ## 安装（DSH） ### 从插件市场（推荐） 打开 **插件 → 实验性插件 → 更多 → 自定义插件市场**，添加索引源： ```text https://leonz666.github.io/dsh-gitworktree-gui/market/index.json ``` 然后在 **发现** 里搜索「Git 工作树面板」点安装。 ### 从 npm 安装 插件已发布到 npm：`dsh-gitworktree-gui`。终端里用 DSH CLI 装进指定 profile（需要本机有 `dsh` 与 `pnpm`，命令会把参数转发给 profile 目录里的 pnpm，从 npm 解析包）： ```sh npm view dsh-gitworktree-gui version # 查看最新版本，可选 dsh plugin --profile add dsh-gitworktree-gui dsh plugin --profile add dsh-gitworktree-gui@<版本> # 固定版本 ``` 桌面端 profile 由 Electron 管理，请用下面的插件页 / `plugin_manager`；CLI 的插件管理请求不作用于它。 ### 在 DSH 里直接安装 在插件页或 `plugin_manager` 工具里： ```text plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ``` `target` 也可以是下面几种形式： - `git+https://github.com/LeonZ666/dsh-gitworktree-gui.git` — 直接装当前 `main`（不要用 `github:` 简写，匿名用户会走 SSH） - `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui-<版本>.tgz` — 离线包，仓库根执行 `npm pack` 得到 - `/绝对路径/dsh-gitworktree-gui` — 本地源码，`link:` 安装，改代码即时生效 `engines.dsh` 要求 `>=0.2.1-rc.2`，不满足时安装会被拒绝并回滚。装好后刷新 Web 页面；改过宿主入口 `index.js` / `lib/` 需要重开 DSH。
更新与卸载 用新 spec 再执行一次 `install_bundle`；同名包已安装时先卸载再装。 ```text plugin_manager action=set_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui enabled=false plugin_manager action=remove_bundle target=dsh-gitworktree-gui ```
## 使用 1. 点会话头部右上角的 Git 图标，面板作为右栏标签打开。 2. 默认读取当前会话目录；顶部条始终显示正在查看的 worktree 的路径、分支与状态。 3. 在 WORKTREES 里点其他工作树，只切换「看哪棵树」，不执行 checkout，也不改变聊天的工作目录；「返回会话工作区」回到默认目录。 4. 点提交看完整消息、改动文件和 diff；点分支线段选路径；点工作树看 HEAD、上游和 dirty 文件数。 5. CHANGES / FILES 里的文件行点开，会在侧边栏新开一个 tab 显示文件内容；关闭 Git 面板标签页即停止轮询。 6. 目录还没 `git init` 时，面板会给出提示；初始化后点「已初始化，重新读取」。插件不会替你初始化或修改仓库。

点开提交：完整消息、改动文件与单文件 diff 在同一栏展开。

## 只读与边界 只读：不提交、不切分支、不合并、不删除工作树、不初始化仓库。Git 用固定参数的 `execFile`，不拼 shell；DSH 路由只接受 loopback，显式路径受 `allowedRoots` 限制。采集上限为 120 个提交 / 700 个文件（提交详情 300 个文件，单文件 diff 128 KiB / 1200 行），读取失败会保留旧快照并标记过期，而不是显示成干净。 ## License [MIT](LICENSE) · 开发：`npm ci && npm run verify` · 发布见 [RELEASING.md](RELEASING.md) 在 Codex 和 Claude 上也能安装，适配入口见 [`codex/`](codex/) 与 [`hooks/`](hooks/)。

plugins.description: TypeSafe Jev for DeepSeek Harness, the Model Context Protocol, and plain Node: typed judgments instead of prose, offline by default.
plugins.readme_text:
# jevcore
[![dshfind](https://dshfind.com/api/badge/PerryLink/jevcore?metric=downloads)](https://dshfind.com/plugins/PerryLink/jevcore?ref=badge)

[![DSH Market](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/2BingLing/dsh-market/master/assets/readme/badge-listed-en.svg)](https://dsh.market/)
[![OpenSSF Scorecard](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore/badge)](https://api.securityscorecards.dev/projects/github.com/PerryLink/jevcore)
[![jevcore MCP server](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore/badges/score.svg)](https://glama.ai/mcp/servers/PerryLink/jevcore)

TypeSafe [Jev](https://typesafe.ai) for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
and any other MCP host.

Jev is not a chat model. It answers typed questions — `noul` (yes/no), `choice`, `score` — and returns
calibrated probabilities. It does not write prose, and asking it to is a category error. This project
gives an agent exactly that surface, and nothing more.

**Offline by default. Egress disclosed. Nothing default-on.**

---

**📖 Ecosystem knowledge base** — measured data, not marketing: [plugin development guide · plugin-selection data · maintenance criteria](https://perrylink.github.io/dsh-plugin-guide/).

<!-- star-cta -->
## ⭐ 如果它帮到了你

这个插件是 [DSH 插件家族](https://github.com/PerryLink)的一员（95 个，全部 Apache-2.0）。如果你在用，**给个 star** —— 它不会解锁任何功能，但会让下一个人在搜索里更容易找到它。

*English:* part of a 95 plugin family for DeepSeek Harness. If it is useful, **a star helps the next person find it** — nothing is gated behind it.


## Three packages, one decision layer

| Package | What it is | Use it when |
|---|---|---|
| [`jevcore`](packages/core) | The decisions. Imports nothing from DeepSeek Harness or Cordis. | You want Jev in a plain script, a service, or your own harness |
| [`jevcore-dsh`](packages/dsh) | The DSH plugin: one service, three tools, two opt-in gates | You are running DeepSeek Harness |
| [`jevcore-mcp`](packages/mcp) | The same three tools over MCP, with a stdio binary | Your host speaks MCP but is not DSH |

The adapters are thin on purpose. `packages/dsh` is four files: it declares tool schemas and
translates hook payloads. Everything decision-shaped — the primitives, the providers, the egress
contract, the policy, the gates — lives in core, so a new adapter cannot drift from the guarantees
the others make.
One runtime requirement differs across the three: `jevcore-dsh` tracks the harness and needs
Node `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, while `jevcore` and `jevcore-mcp` need `>=20`.

---

## Why this exists

Between 2026-09-17 and 09-20, nineteen plugins appeared that wire Jev into DSH. Auditing their source
found a consistent pattern: the module labelled *guard*, *gate*, or *warden* was also the module
shipping prompts, tool arguments, and file contents to a third party, and the README generally did not
say so. Several were enabled by default. One gate could be reconfigured by the model it was guarding.

This project is the same idea with those failure modes designed out:

| Property | How it is guaranteed here |
|---|---|
| No network call unless you ask for one | Default provider is an offline mock; the live path needs both `provider: live` and a resolved credential |
| Every transmission named before it happens | One startup log line per feature: `off` or `SENDS <feature> { fields }` |
| Gates register nothing when disabled | Verified by test, not by policy — a disabled gate adds no event listener at all |
| The model cannot widen its own constraints | No tool exposes gate configuration |
| A judge that cannot answer never means "allow" | Undecided resolves through explicit config, defaulting to `ask` |

---

## The egress contract

This is the part worth reading before installing.

Transmission is decided per feature, and every feature defaults to off. The plugin prints its own
contract at load:

```
[jevcore] provider=mock  endpoint=none  egress=OFF  (no network calls will be made; every answer is synthetic)
[jevcore] ready - provider=mock - gates: safety=off context=off
```

With `provider: live` and every feature enabled, the same report becomes explicit about what leaves:

```
[jevcore] provider=live  endpoint=https://api.typesafe.ai  egress=ON
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_ask  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_rank  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  tool:jev_check  { state<=16000c questions<=4000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:safety  { state<=8000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   SENDS  gate:context  { state<=6000c questions<=2000c }
[jevcore]   redaction is best-effort; it removes named fields and known secret shapes, and cannot
             recognise an unrecognised secret in free text
```

| Feature | Off by default? | What it sends |
|---|---|---|
| `tool:jev_ask` | runs when the model calls it | the arguments the model passed, after redaction |
| `tool:jev_rank` | runs when the model calls it | the query plus every candidate |
| `tool:jev_check` | runs when the model calls it | the claim and its evidence |
| `gate:safety` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | the tool name, its arguments, the workspace root |
| `gate:context` | **yes — explicit opt-in** | a large tool result the agent just received |

The tools transmit only when the model chooses to call them, which is visible in the transcript. The
gates would run on every matching tool call, which is not, so they are opt-in.

### Redaction, and its honest limit

Before anything is sent, `src/redact.ts` runs two passes: values under sensitive field names
(`password`, `token`, `apiKey`, `authorization`, …) are replaced wholesale, and secret-shaped strings
that survive into free text are pattern-matched (`Bearer …`, `sk-…`, `ts_live_…`, AWS/GitHub/Google
key shapes, JWTs, private-key headers, credentials in connection strings).

This is a mitigation, not a permission. A secret that sits under an unrecognised key name *and* does
not match a known shape will pass through. If that possibility is unacceptable for your workload, do
not enable the live provider.

---

## Install

### As a DeepSeek Harness plugin

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add jevcore-dsh
```

Or from a checkout:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/dsh
```

`packages/dsh` imports `jevcore` by name, so a checkout also needs core
resolvable from the profile (`add /absolute/path/to/jevcore/packages/core`).

Then confirm the row activated — the plugin list should show `jev` as `active`,
not `failed` — and check the startup report in the log.

### As an MCP server

For a host that speaks MCP, the same three tools are available over stdio:

```sh
npx -y jevcore-mcp
```

To wire it into DeepSeek Harness specifically, install a configuration-only bundle
whose patch inserts the harness's own MCP client:

```yml
- insert:
    - id: jev-mcp
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
      config:
        serverName: jev
        transport: stdio
        command: npx
        args: ['-y', 'jevcore-mcp']
        env:
          TYPESAFE_API_KEY: '<the key>'
        failOnStartupError: true
```

The env map is not optional: DSH strips every credential-shaped name — anything
containing KEY, PASSWORD, SECRET or TOKEN, in any case — from the environment it
hands a spawned server, then merges this map back in afterwards. A key exported in
your shell never arrives, and the server stays on the offline mock without
reporting an error.

The provider is chosen from the environment:

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `TYPESAFE_API_KEY` | Selects the TypeSafe route when present |
| `OPENROUTER_API_KEY` | Selects the OpenRouter route when present and no TypeSafe key is set |
| `JEV_PROVIDER` | `mock`, `live`, or `openrouter` — overrides the heuristic above |
| `TYPESAFE_MODEL` / `OPENROUTER_MODEL` | Model id for the selected route |
| `TYPESAFE_BASE_URL` / `OPENROUTER_BASE_URL` | API root for the selected route |

With neither key it stays on the offline mock. Unlike the plugin, the MCP server
resolves its credential once at startup, so a missing key with
`JEV_PROVIDER=live` is a startup error rather than a per-call surprise.

Its egress report goes

plugins.description: Grok for DeepSeek Harness: model discovery, chat provider, image and video generation, TTS and durable local media tools over your own OpenAI-compatible gateway.
plugins.readme_text:
![Grok ByAPI for DeepSeek Harness](docs/assets/banner.svg)

# dsh-grok-byapi

Native Grok for DeepSeek Harness: a chat provider plus image, video, and TTS tools over your own OpenAI-compatible Grok gateway.

[![CI](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green.svg)](LICENSE) [![Node >=22.19](https://img.shields.io/badge/node-%3E%3D22.19.0-339933.svg)](#compatibility) [![dsh 0.2.x](https://img.shields.io/badge/dsh-0.2.x-blue.svg)](#compatibility) [![topic: dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-6f42c1.svg)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) [![GitHub tag](https://img.shields.io/github/v/tag/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi?label=tag&include_prereleases)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/tags)

English | [中文](README.zh.md)

> **`0.2.1` on npm `latest`.** Chat routing still depends on the dsh `0.2.1-rc.2` adapter registration; rerun integration tests after a host upgrade. See [VALIDATION.md](VALIDATION.md).

One plugin, one gateway connection. Chat models appear in the model picker; image, video, and TTS models stay out of it and are used through tools instead. Any chat model — Grok or another provider — can call those tools. The plugin talks to a Grok gateway you already run (CLIProxyAPI by default), keeps the API key in the dsh credential service, and saves generated media locally. It is not an OAuth client, does not provide an account or quota, and does not read the Grok CLI OAuth token.

## Demo

| Plugins page | Settings page |
| --- | --- |
| ![Plugin list with dsh-grok-byapi installed](docs/assets/screenshot-plugins.jpg) | ![Plugin settings in the English UI with both components running](docs/assets/screenshot-settings.jpg) |

Both stills below were generated by this plugin with `grok_generate_image` and `grok-imagine-image-2.0`. They are not composited afterward:

| Cool still | Warm still |
| --- | --- |
| ![A curling sheet of paper and a glass sphere reflecting cyan light](docs/assets/demo-still.jpg) | ![The same subject under a warm lamp, with an arc of light leaving the sphere](docs/assets/demo-warm.jpg) |

This GIF is a 4-second `grok_generate_video` clip. It is not a frame-by-frame animation of the still above:

![The paper slowly curls while a cyan light drifts from the sphere](docs/assets/demo-motion.gif)

## Features

| Area | Current scope |
| --- | --- |
| Chat provider | Registers a native dsh LLM provider: route `xAI-CLIProxyAPI`, display name **Grok**. Streaming text and tool calls go through the official pi-ai adapter. |
| Model catalog | `GET /models` discovery, auto-categorized as chat, image, video, speech, research, or unknown. Only chat models enter the picker; unknown models do not. Per-model overrides are available. |
| Settings page | Connection, API key, verification, timeout, the chat-model table (the picker's source of truth), and media-model selection. Copy follows the dsh language (English or Chinese). |
| Durable media tasks | Task records are per session and survive restarts. Downloads write `.part` files and are renamed after validation. Storage is isolated by connection and task. |
| Results in chat | Tool result cards, file preview, and a sidebar player for MP4, MP3, and WAV. Tool cards and the player follow the dsh language. |

Together, the plugin's two components register 10 tools. The plugin page has connection and model settings only. The grok-byapi detail lists chat and the catalog; the dsh-grok-imagine detail lists image, video, and speech:

| Tool | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| `grok_models` | Refreshes the catalog and returns models grouped by capability. Optional `verify_key` checks address and key with one `GET /models`. |
| `grok_generate_image` | Text to image: `prompt`, optional `model`, `n` (1–4, default 1). |
| `grok_edit_image` | Image to image: `prompt` plus `image_url` / `image_urls` (up to 5) or a saved image task. |
| `grok_generate_video` | Text to video, or image to video when one still (`image_url` or a saved image task) is attached. `duration` is 1–15 seconds, default 2. |
| `grok_edit_video` | Video to video: edit an existing video from a prompt (`video_url` or a saved video task). |
| `grok_extend_video` | Continues from the last frame and joins that to the original clip. |
| `grok_speak` | Text to speech saved as MP3: `input`, optional `model` and `voice`. |
| `grok_media_list` | Lists media tasks created in the current session. |
| `grok_media_status` | Checks a task and downloads the result when ready: `task_id`. |
| `grok_media_retry_download` | Retries a failed download without regenerating: `task_id`. |

Not provided: speech recognition, realtime voice, direct OAuth, and a live task dashboard. Video jobs are polled in-process after submit, but the result card does not refresh itself. Classification is rule-based, not a guarantee.

## Compatibility

| Component | Requirement | Verified |
| --- | --- | --- |
| dsh | `>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0-0` via `engines.dsh` | `0.2.1-rc.2` end to end (chat, image, video, TTS, playback) |
| Node.js | `>=22.19.0` | Node 24 on Windows; CI runs Node 22.19 and 24 on Linux and Windows |
| Gateway | OpenAI-compatible `/v1` endpoint; CLIProxyAPI recommended | CLIProxyAPI v8.0.30 |
| Other dsh 0.2.x | Inside the `engines.dsh` range | Not individually verified |

`engines.dsh` is the compatibility gate; `peerDependencies` pin the SDK packages the source uses but do not decide compatibility, so rerun the integration tests after a dsh upgrade. A direct xAI or other compatible endpoint can serve chat, but image, video, and TTS need the gateway to expose the matching Grok endpoints.

## Install

**From npm (recommended):**

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add dsh-grok-byapi
```

That installs the current `latest`, which is `0.2.1`.

**From git, pinned to a tag:**

```powershell
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "git+https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git#v0.2.1"
```

`--dump-config` creates the profile from your default profile and prints the merged configuration without starting a server. `dsh plugin add` records the bundle in that profile — no manual YAML edit. The package has no `prepare` or `postinstall` script, so installation runs no build code and needs no `allowBuilds` entry.

**From a GitHub Release tarball (once the release is published):**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi/releases/download/v0.2.1/dsh-grok-byapi-0.2.1.tgz"
```

**From local source (development):**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-grok-byapi.git
cd dsh-grok-byapi
npm install --ignore-scripts
dsh --profile grok-byapi-test --from-default-profile web --dump-config
dsh plugin --profile grok-byapi-test add "$PWD"   # bash/zsh: "$(pwd)"
```

Start dsh with that profile:

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-quick-launcher

A `Ctrl + Space` command palette for the DeepSeek Harness **Web UI** — one
rectangular box to find sessions, invoke skills, jump to plugins / panels /
settings, and switch appearance. Raycast / Spotlight style.

[中文说明 ↓](#中文说明)

## Install

`--profile` names the Harness profile to install into (`web`, `desktop`, …; it
is **required**). The rest is forwarded to `pnpm add` in that profile directory.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-quick-launcher                 # from npm
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sadkga/dsh-quick-launcher   # or from GitHub
```

Pin an exact release with `… add github:sadkga/dsh-quick-launcher#v1.0.0`, or
`… add dsh-quick-launcher@1.0.0` for the npm form.

Then restart the Harness (`systemctl --user restart dsh.service`, or restart the
`dsh web` process) and press `Ctrl + Space`.

Inside a conversation you can also just ask the agent to install
`dsh-quick-launcher`.

## What it finds

| Group | Contents |
| --- | --- |
| **Recently used** | What you launched last, with *Back to conversation* pinned first |
| **Sessions** | Session list (title / working directory); archive set, subagent children and stale blank rows are filtered out to mirror the sidebar |
| **Skills** | The skill catalog of the session in view, as `/name` rows |
| **Plugins** | Every registered plugin row (including the ones a bundle contributes, such as the task board or the marketplace) |
| **Settings** | Every page inside the settings dialog |
| **Commands** | New session, panel navigation, toggle sidebar, archive current session |
| **Appearance** | Light / dark / follow system |

`↑↓←→` move (down and up step by group, so a one-row group never gets skipped),
`Enter` runs, `Esc` closes. The gear button opens the palette's own settings
(recommendations on/off), kept out of the search rows on purpose.

## How it is built

- **`shell.overlay`**: the palette is one entry in the frame-wide overlay layer,
  which is click-through; the component returns `null` while closed.
- **No cross-plugin imports.** A client bundle may not import another plugin's
  modules, so everything is local: the shell's own product icons are inlined as
  path data, and styles use only `--dsw-*` tokens plus the frame inset
  variables.
- **Capabilities via `ctx.inject`.** Cordis activates a service for whoever
  injects it, while `ctx.get()` only reports an already-active fiber
  (`strict = true`). Probing with `get` yields `undefined` on first paint and
  silently empties whole groups. `remote` is a static dependency because the
  dotted namespaces (`remote.pluginManager`, `remote.skills`) are properties of
  that service, not services of their own.
- **Icons are the shell's own.** `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/icons/` is
  the source of the geometry; the shapes are copied as data, stroked with
  `currentColor`.

## Why `Ctrl + Space` is not a shortcut-service binding

Web only accepts a very narrow set of default combinations
(`packages/client/shortcuts/src/binding.ts:96` — on Web/Linux exactly `Ctrl+/`,
`Ctrl+Shift+,` and `Ctrl+Shift+.`). Registering `Ctrl+Space` as a default throws
`Unsupported Web shortcut`, and a throwing `register()` takes the whole entry
down (`1 entry did not activate` in the UI). So the palette does both:

- offers the service a **legal default per platform**, so the command appears in
  the shortcuts catalog and stays rebindable;
- carries `Ctrl + Space` itself with a **private capture-phase listener**, which
  is why it works regardless of platform.

## Known limitations

- **Content search depends on the deployment.** The palette calls
  `sessions.search`, but the Web bundle ships the query index with
  `openAt: 'never'` (`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`), so full-text
  search over message bodies is off by default. When the Host refuses the
  search the palette says so instead of pretending there were no matches.
  Title and working-directory matching always works.
- **The settings dialog cannot be opened by API.** It owns its open state with
  no public Client service, so settings *pages* are searchable and are activated
  by driving the dialog's own rendered navigation.
- Icon artwork inside the shell's product icon set only; no other imagery.
- Client code is cached by the Host until the process restarts
  (`packages/client/modules/src/index.ts`, *cached … until restart*), so any
  change to `client.js` needs a restart to take effect.

## Layout

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Host half. The launcher is pure browser surface, so this row only makes the bundle a first-class, toggleable, titled entry in the plugin inventory. |
| `client.js` | Client half: the overlay component, the shortcut, and every action. |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader patch inserting the `quick-launcher` row. |
| `locale/{en,zh}.json` | Title and description shown by the plugin manager. |
| `icon.svg` | Original 48×48 icon. |

## License

MIT

---

## 中文说明

一个装在 DeepSeek Harness **Web UI** 里的全局快捷面板（Raycast / Spotlight 风格）。

- **唤出**：`Ctrl + Space`（也注册成了快捷键目录里的普通应用命令，可改键）。
- **能搜**：最近使用、会话、技能、插件、设置页、命令、外观。
- **键盘**：`↑↓←→` 移动（上下按分组步进，单行分组不会被跳过），`Enter` 执行，`Esc` 关闭。
- **齿轮**：打开面板自己的设置（推荐开关），设置项刻意不出现在搜索结果里。

### 安装

```bash
# --profile 是必填的（web / desktop / …），其余参数原样转交给 pnpm add
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-quick-launcher
# 或从 GitHub
dsh plugin --profile web add github:sadkga/dsh-quick-launcher
```

装完需要重启 Harness，然后按 `Ctrl + Space`。

### 设计要点

- 浮层挂在 `shell.overlay`（该层默认 click-through，关闭时组件返回 `null`，不挡页面）。
- **不 import 任何其他插件的模块**：图标几何数据内联（取自 Harness 自带的产品图标集），样式只用 `--dsw-*` token，明暗主题都跟随。
- **能力一律用 `ctx.inject()` 借**：cordis 是"谁 inject 谁触发激活"，`ctx.get()` 只看已激活的 fiber，用它探测会整组消失；`remote` 用静态 inject，因为 `pluginManager` / `skills` 是它身上的属性而不是独立服务。
- **`Ctrl+Space` 不走快捷键服务的默认键**：Web 端只放行极少几种组合，注册它会抛错并拖垮整条 entry。所以既给服务一份各平台合法的默认值（可改键），又用自己的 window 监听器承载 `Ctrl+Space`。

### 已知限制

- **内容全文检索取决于部署**：Web bundle 默认把索引设为 `openAt: 'never'`，所以消息正文搜索默认关闭；被拒绝时面板会明确说明，而不是假装"没有匹配"。标题与工作目录匹配始终可用。
- **设置对话框无法由 API 打开**：它自己持有打开状态，没有公开服务；设置项可以搜到，靠驱动它已渲染的导航来切换。
- 改动 `client.js` 后必须重启 Harness 才会重新组合（Host 会把 client 元数据缓存到进程重启）。

# dsh-image-viewer-pro [![license: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE) [![DSH](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-%E2%89%A50.2.1--rc.2-4D6BFE)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) [![release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro?sort=semver)](https://github.com/NingYuanLee/dsh-image-viewer-pro/releases) **A viewer for images inside a DeepSeek Harness conversation — not a close button with a picture behind it.** Zoom, pan, rotate, a gallery, download, copy, a dialog you can drag, and open-with the apps already on the machine, in one layer. Wheel, drag, and rotate update on the compositor once per frame; the next image is decoded before it is shown, so a page turn does not flash at the wrong size. It replaces the stock preview that only offers Close. English | [中文](README.zh.md) ![Viewer preview](docs/preview.png) ## See it The pictures below are the real viewer, opened on photographs made for this page. The GIF plays on GitHub; the MP4 link is the same take.

**Zoom and pan.** The wheel zooms around the pointer; dragging moves the picture. ![Zoom and pan](docs/zoom.gif) [zoom.mp4](docs/zoom.mp4) **Rotate.** Each click turns 90°. The footer shows the angle. ![Rotate](docs/rotate.gif) [rotate.mp4](docs/rotate.mp4) **Gallery.** The side arrows and `←` / `→` move through the images in the conversation. The new picture slides in from that side. ![Gallery](docs/gallery.gif) [gallery.mp4](docs/gallery.mp4) **Move the dialog.** Drag the title bar. The window stays inside the backdrop. ![Move the dialog](docs/move.gif) [move.mp4](docs/move.mp4) **Copy and download.** Copy writes a PNG and shows a toast; download saves the original. ![Copy and download](docs/actions.gif) [actions.mp4](docs/actions.mp4) ## Why The stock image preview in DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 only offers **Close**: no zoom, no pan, no rotate, no download, no switching between the images of one conversation. This plugin takes over content-image clicks in the **capture phase** and renders its own dialog — it does not depend on official slot contracts, so it stays working when image slots change. The viewer improves *looking*; it cannot make an image appear. See [Getting images into the conversation](#getting-images-into-the-conversation) for prompt rules that get an agent to inline images in the first place. ## Features - **Zoom** — wheel zooms around the pointer. One mouse notch is about 12% and eases in over a few frames; trackpad ticks stay continuous. The footer shows `− [percent] +` and the percentage is editable (Enter applies, Esc reverts). A tap on ± matches one notch; holding ± zooms continuously (about one doubling every 0.7s). Keyboard `+` / `-` stays a 25% step. The scale stays within 5%–4000%. - **Pan** — drag the canvas; double-click toggles fit ↔ actual size. - **Footer** — the controls sit in three groups separated by hairlines: zoom, fit / 1:1, and rotate. - **Move the dialog** — drag its title bar; the dialog stays inside the backdrop (never over the desktop's native title/menu bar) and is pulled back into bounds when the window is resized. - **Header info** — the title row shows `width × height | format | file size` with values only; the format is uppercase (JPG/PNG/SVG/BMP/WEBP…) and the size switches between B, KB and MB (one decimal for KB/MB). - **Rotate** — counterclockwise on the left, clockwise on the right, 90° per click, with the current angle centered between them. - **Download original** — with progress; saves to the system downloads folder. - **Copy image** — writes a PNG to the clipboard. - **Gallery** — browse the other images in the same conversation with the round side arrows or `←` / `→`; shows `current / total`. The incoming picture pushes in from the side you asked for and the previous one leaves the other way, about 420ms on the same curve as the dialog open. A second step settles the one already playing. Reduced motion still cuts straight across. - **Open** — a local file uses a split button. The main face shows the default app's icon and opens the file with that app; the menu lists every associated app reported by `session.workspacePathApplications` (the default is marked) and ends with "Show file location". A remote `http(s)` image stays a new-tab button. `blob:` and `data:` sources hide it. Opening and revealing both go through the Host's `session.openWorkspacePath`. - **Native look** — the backdrop covers the window content area (the app's own top toolbar included) but stops below the desktop frame's native title/menu bar on Windows (`--dsh-frame-chrome-top`), and the dialog moves only inside that area; both use DSH theme tokens, follow light/dark, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`. ## What it takes over | Image | Viewer | | --- | --- | | Markdown images in message text (`![](...)`, http(s) or the Host file route) | ✅ | | Images attached to user and assistant messages (DSH renders them as `blob:` URLs) | ✅ | | Tool-result images such as `read_image` (same attachment channel) | ✅ | | Icons, avatars and status images below 48px | ❌ stay native | | Images inside the plugin's own dialog (recursion guard) | ❌ | Only the click behaviour is intercepted: message content is not modified, no session data is written, and the page returns to normal after closing the dialog. ## Getting images into the conversation The viewer only improves *looking*. Whether an image appears at all is decided by what the agent emits: DSH renders Markdown images from the reply and image attachments from tool results, and this plugin takes over the click afterwards. Most agents summarise UI work in text ("the layout looks correct") and never inline a single picture — which is why the feature is easy to overlook. Add the rules below to your global `AGENTS.md`, a project `AGENTS.md`, or the custom-instructions field. They are deliberately imperative: "inline every image" steers a model far more reliably than "you may attach screenshots". **Images always inline** ```markdown ## Images - Any image you produce, find, or refer to (including screenshots) must be shown inline: `![description]()`. - Show it without being asked. Never reply with only a file path or only a `present` file card — the image is part of the reply. - Use an absolute path with forward slashes and wrap the destination in angle brackets. A relative path only resolves when the viewed session has a workspace root; otherwise it renders as a broken image. - Download remote images into the workspace first, then inline the local file. - Inline images only. Code, documents and spreadsheets follow the delivery rules of their own tools. ``` **UI verification ends with a screenshot** ```markdown ## UI verification and screenshots - Verify UI and interaction questions in a real session: open → snapshot/screenshot → operate → check Console/Network. Do not substitute reading source code or reasoning for verification. - At the end of the verification, inline the key screenshots in the reply and state which step each one shows. Do not paste only paths. - Save screenshots into the workspace and inline them with `![description]()`. - Write local origins (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, any port) as inline code, never as clickable links, and note "open it in your system browser". ``` Why these constraints: - DSH serves inline local images through an authenticated file route (`GET /api/file?path=`, mounted by its session media references). It accepts POSIX absolute paths and Windows drive-letter paths; DSH's own docs note that this route needs an HTTP(S) page, so desktop `dsh-app:` pages do not support it. - Relative chat image paths only resolve when the viewed session has a workspace root, so absolute paths are the portable choice. - Tool-result images (`read_image`, browser screenshots) already arrive as rendered attachments and are picked up a
