• 可视化呈现历史会话数、消息量、Token 总消耗及活跃天数
• 统计高峰活跃时段与常用模型分布，内置 GitHub 风格交互热力图
• 支持「全部历史 / 30 天 / 7 天」多时间窗口快速切换
• 高效内存缓存与异步聚合，毫秒级即时响应 | > **架构解耦保障**：三款插件各司其职、完全解耦，支持任意单独安装或组合使用。各插件严格遵循所有权隔离原则，仅声明并操作专属的设计令牌与扩展槽位，杜绝状态竞争与样式污染。 ## 快速上手 · Installation ### 1. 构建与添加插件 在目标插件目录下构建产物，并通过 `link:` 软链形式添加至宿主 Profile： ```bash # 以 cds-theme 为例：构建客户端产物（使用 link 协议时宿主不会自动触发构建） cd plugins/cds-theme && npm ci && npm run build && cd - # 将插件软链添加至指定 Profile（以 desktop Profile 为例） dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:C:/Users/17445/Desktop/HwFee-dsh/plugins/cds-theme ``` > [!IMPORTANT] > **必须完全重启宿主程序**： > 安装或卸载插件后，**必须彻底退出并重启 DeepSeek Harness**。插件的生命周期装载与依赖注入发生于宿主 Profile 的初始化启动阶段，无法在已运行的实例中热重载生效。 ### 2. 协议选型建议（`link:` vs `file:`） - **开发与本地使用（推荐）**：使用 `link:` 软链协议。宿主 Profile 直接指向本地工程目录，修改源码并编译后，仅需重启 DSH 即可直接生效，无需重复安装。 - **固化分发**：使用 `file:` 协议将产物完整复制至 Profile 存储目录中，适合固定发布版本。 ### 3. 卸载插件 ```bash dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-cds-theme ``` ### 4. 三种安装入口分别填什么 · What to type where DSH 有三处可以装插件，**它们接受的东西不一样**。下表是实测结果，不是推测： | 入口 | 填什么 | 实测 | |---|---|---| | **命令行** | `dsh plugin --profile

add ` | 见下 | | **GUI：设置 → 插件 → 添加插件** | 下面任一 **spec**（和命令行同一个解析器） | 走 `pluginManager.installBundle` | | **GUI：插件 → 发现**（需开启「自定义插件市场」） | 一个 **index.json 的 URL**，不是包名 | 市场源 | 命令行与 GUI 输入框接受**同一个 spec**，可用的有： ```bash # ① 本地路径（开发用，推荐） link:C:/Users/17445/Desktop/HwFee-dsh/plugins/cds-theme # ② 已发布的 npm 包名（需要先 npm publish） dsh-cds-theme @hwfee/dsh-usage-stats # ③ tarball URL（不需要 npm 账号，推荐给使用者） https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz # ④ 本地 tarball 文件 C:/path/to/dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz ``` **❌ git 地址装不了子目录插件。** 这条实测过，写下来免得再踩： ```bash # 下面两种写法都会失败 git+https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh.git#&path:/plugins/system-fonts https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/tree//plugins/system-fonts ``` 原因：pnpm 处理 git 依赖时**只装仓库根**，`&path:` / `&path:plugins/...` 都被忽略。你的仓库根没有 `package.json`（更没有 `dsh.bundle`），于是： - 最好的情况：装进整个仓库、生成一个占位 `package.json`，警告 `declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer`； - 最坏的情况：直接失败。 **所以给别人装，用 ③ tarball URL；自己开发，用 ① link:。** 如果确实要走 git，必须让仓库根就是插件根（一个仓库一个插件）。 > 三个插件当前的 Release 资产： > `dsh-cds-theme-0.1.0.tgz`（7.5 MB）、`dsh-system-fonts-0.1.0.tgz`（80 KB）、`hwfee-dsh-usage-stats-0.1.0.tgz`（81 KB），见 [Releases](https://github.com/HwFee/HwFee-dsh/releases/tag/v0.1.0)。 ### 5. 发布到 npm 完整教程见 [`market/PUBLISHING.md`](market/PUBLISHING.md)，含 2FA 那道坎的两个解法。要点： - 本机 `.npmrc` 默认 registry 是 `registry.npmmirror.com`（**只读镜像，不能发布**），三个包已用 `publishConfig.registry` 钉到官方源； - npm 现在要求发布时通过 2FA：要么在**能弹浏览器的终端**里 `npm login`，要么用勾了 `bypass 2fa` 的 granular token； - **镜像站不用管**：它是单向只读同步，包进了官方 npm 后会自动出现，DSH 的镜像支持在读取侧（自动回退），不需要配置。 ## 本地开发与工作流 · Development 每个插件目录均为标准的独立包，可在各自目录下独立执行开发生命周期命令： ```bash npm ci # 安装开发依赖（仅依赖 esbuild，无任何运行时外部依赖） npm test # 执行产物新鲜度检查及全量自动化测试套件 npm run build # 编译打包客户端源码：client/src/* -> client/client.js ``` ### 关键工程约束 1. **构建产物纳入版本控制**： `client/client.js` 为随仓库提交的预编译分发文件。由于 `link:` 软链模式在宿主启动时不会自动执行编译，产物必须与源码时刻保持严格同步。`npm test` 启动时首先执行新鲜度核验（`build-client.mjs --check`），若构建产物落后于源码将直接阻断测试。 2. **LF 换行符强约束**： 仓库通过 `.gitattributes` 强制指定所有文件采用 LF 换行符。因新鲜度校验采取二进制逐字节比对，在 Windows 环境下若开启 `core.autocrlf=true`，检出的源码将携带 CRLF 换行符，经 esbuild 打包后会引入字节偏移（实测多出 83 字节），导致全新克隆环境下的自动化测试失败。 ## 质量审计与自动化验证 · Verification 仓库根目录与各插件内置了完善的自动化审计与端到端验证套件： ```bash # 仓库级架构与安全审计 # 检查项包括：体积预算红线、DOM 安全性、无动态代码注入(eval/new Function)、监听器及定时器生命周期闭环、配置契约一致性 node tools/audit.mjs # CDS 主题端到端规格验证（覆盖 73 项设计令牌、排印阶梯、样式隔离与回退断言） cd plugins/cds-theme && node tools/verify.mjs ``` ## 仓库结构 · Repository Structure ``` HwFee-dsh/ ├── plugins/ # 独立插件包目录 │ ├── cds-theme/ # Claude Design System 主题插件 │ │ ├── client/src/ # 客户端 ESM 源代码 │ │ ├── client/client.js # 预编译客户端 Bundle（提交入库） │ │ ├── lib/index.js # Host 端后台服务（字体基址注入与长粘贴智能路由） │ │ ├── locale/ # 国际化字典（en.json / zh.json） │ │ ├── test/ # 基于 node:test 的单元测试套件 │ │ └── tools/ # 专用构建、验证与基准测试脚本 │ ├── system-fonts/ # 系统字体与排印定制插件（同等工程结构） │ └── usage-stats/ # 会话用量统计分析插件（同等工程结构） ├── docs/ # 技术规范与考证依据 │ ├── cds-spec.md # CDS 设计系统全量规范（逐行引证与冲突仲裁表） │ ├── host-hooks.md # 宿主 DOM 结构、CSS 覆写点与安全样式锚点勘察 │ ├── reference-absorption-ledger.md # 上游规范吸收台账 │ ├── replication-toggles.md # 复刻特性与设置项开关约定 │ └── perf-audit.md # 性能基准测量与资源预算指标 ├── assets/ # 文档截图与静态资源 ├── skills/ # 第三方插件开发知识库（遵循 Apache-2.0） └── tools/ # 仓库级静态审计与辅助工具集 ``` ## 参考资料与技术依据 · References `docs/` 目录中的技术文档构成本仓库技术方案与设计决策的严密支撑： - [`docs/cds-spec.md`](docs/cds-spec.md) —— 逐行考证自 `open-claude-ui` 的 CDS 设计规范，包含对上游 18 处规范冲突的仲裁结论与裁定表。 - [`docs/host-hooks.md`](docs/host-hooks.md) —— 宿主 DOM/CSS 覆写点深度勘察报告：梳理可靠的 `data-*` 样式钩子、规避混淆哈希类名，以及解释 `--dsw-elevation-*` 必须使用 `!important` 样式表覆盖的技术原理。 `.reference/open-claude-ui` 为参考上游的只读克隆镜像（遵循 MIT 协议），**已列入 `.gi

plugins.description: 毛颖——DeepSeek Harness 网文创作辅助插件：主编五帮手编排（大纲/正文/审校/设定/考据）、novel/ 文件化书稿、创作台面板、共创模式
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-maoying（毛颖）

毛颖者，笔也——韩愈作《毛颖传》，把一支毛笔写成有封地有爵位的臣子。dsh-maoying 把这支笔装进 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）：**一支管着一班帮手、守着一摞书稿的毛笔**——网文创作辅助插件，全部实现原创，MIT 发布。

装上之后，主 agent 变身**网文主编（创作总监）**：带七阶段工作流与六步写作法，把大纲、正文、审校、设定维护、素材考据分别委派给五个只带本行工具的帮手；整部小说就是工作区里的 `novel/` 结构化 markdown/YAML 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、线索板、叙事记忆）——agent 直接读写文件，**没有数据库，没有 API 层**。查「所有未回收伏笔」就是 grep 一行。

## 功能特性

- **主编 + 五帮手**：主 agent 当主编，只做规划、衔接、验收、状态推进；大纲师（outline）、写手（write）、审校（review）、设定管理员（lore）、素材调研员（research）各带本行工具随叫随到。找文件、查伏笔状态这类顺手小事主编自己 glob/grep 就办，不绕委派。
- **novel/ 文件数据库**：角色卡、世界观、科学设定三色标注、关系图、伏笔账本、时间线、叙事记忆、线索板，全部是 grep 友好的平键/顶层数组 YAML——人可直接改，git 可版本化，无迁移无运维。
- **七阶段工作流**：idea 选题 → setting 设定 → outline 大纲 → writing 写作 → review 审阅 → consistency 一致性 → export 导出。阶段记在 project.yml 的 phase 键，每完成一个里程碑主编推进并简报。
- **Writing 六步法**：衔接检查 → 出大纲 → 写正文 → 审稿 → 修改 → 定稿维护，逐章循环；配合 Collab 四步共创（设定共创 → 分卷规划 → 黄金三章 → 交接循环）把新书从零带到滚动更新。
- **伏笔状态机**：planted（埋设）→ progressing（推进）→ resolved（回收）/ abandoned（弃用），埋设与回收记章节号、预期回收章节排期、优先级分档——长篇不断线，活跃伏笔超 15 条主编主动提醒清理。
- **上下文按需取**：主编先读 index.yml 概览，写到哪章读哪章（前章结尾约 1500 字 + 该章大纲 + 出场角色卡 + 活跃伏笔节选），不把整本书塞进上下文。
- **工具面收窄**：主编只见「角色委派 + 内部检索 + 协调」白名单，帮手各带本行工具（审校只读、考据只带联网+落笔记）；每次请求的工具开销与上下文占用随之下降。
- **素材考据**：research 帮手联网检索历史/地理/专业领域素材，笔记落 `novel/research/`，区分史实/通说/演义并附来源——DSH 架构的红利。
- **CLI 兜底**：`maoying init / stats / index` 三条零依赖命令管脚手架、字数统计与章节概览重建。

## 快速开始

前置：**Node.js ≥ 18**、已装好的 DSH host（**0.1.7+**，见「兼容面」）。

官方插件通道——一条命令，装完重启即用：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-maoying
```

**重启 DSH（`dsh web`）**：插件启动时自动把预设装进 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/maoying/`，并在 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 写好声明行托管块，无需再点任何按钮。新会话的预设选择器里选「**毛颖创作 (Maoying)**」即可开写；要设为默认，在 Settings → Agent Presets 里选。

开发检出（想改插件或预设源码）用 link 形态直连仓库，改动经重启生效：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/lifangjin/dsh-maoying.git
dsh plugin --profile web add link:"$PWD/dsh-maoying"
```

只要命令行工具、不装插件的读者：零依赖 CLI 单独可用，`npx` 即跑，或装成全局命令（均为 npm 通道，与插件互不相干）：

```bash
npx maoying init                 # 免安装直接跑
npm install -g dsh-maoying       # 或装成全局 maoying 命令
```

## 怎么用

选好预设后，对主编说话即可，它按工作流自己路由：

**开新书（Collab 四步共创）**：

> 我想写一本东方玄幻，主角靠「听懂器物说话」的金手指鉴宝升级。

主编与你对齐题材与基调，委派设定管理员建核心角色卡与世界观条目，委派大纲师做分卷规划，然后把黄金三章（立世界钩子、立主角动机、立核心冲突）写出来交付。

**逐章写作（Writing 六步法）**：

> 第三章可以开写了吗？

主编做衔接检查，委派大纲师出本章大纲（含五维叙事字段），过目后派写手写正文、审校审稿（清单 + 四维一致性扫描），有问题回写手修，通过后置 accepted 并委派设定管理员做定稿维护——你只需要在决策点拍板。

**集中审查**：

> 前 20 章做一次一致性检查。

主编推进 phase 到 consistency，审校扫描冲突/时间线/伏笔/设定四维，问题按严重度排好交回写手。

用户回「ok / 可以 / 继续」即视为确认，主编直接推进，不复述确认。

## 共创模式（作者亲笔）

不是谁都想让 AI 代笔。project.yml 的 `mode` 键决定正文归谁写，三种模式一句话：`ai-draft`（默认）AI 代笔，走 Writing 六步法；`co-write` 逐章指派谁写，主编动笔前先问清本章归谁；`author-draft` 全书作者亲笔，毛颖只备料、审稿、记账，永不代写。

author-draft 下的协作循环——你只管写，交稿即接管杂务：

> 第 5 章写完了，贴给你。（正文直接粘进对话，或者说一声第 X 章写完、指个文件）

主编收稿后你会拿到三样东西：**审校意见清单**（只挑问题、不代改，改不改随你）、**账本回填**（伏笔/时间线/关系/记忆/线索五本账按你正文实际发生的记，计划外的改动也能认领，来源标 `backfill`）、**下一章章纲**（`novel/outlines/vXX-cXXX.md`，拿着就能写）。圣域纪律：`chapters/` 正文唯作者可改，agent 至多更新 frontmatter 的 summary 与五维字段，且先建议后动手。

配套命令：`maoying brief <dir> <章号>` 打包写作卡（章纲 + 前章结尾 + 角色卡 + 活跃伏笔，带去任意编辑器或其他 AI），`maoying check <dir>` 做零模型静态体检（frontmatter 完整性、伏笔章号引用、时间线乱序等，不调模型——LLM 审校走主编）。

## 方法论技能

随插件带 4 个网文方法论技能，插件启动时安装器把它们落盘到 `~/.dsh/skills/`（即 `<home>/skills/`）下的 `maoying-*` 四个目录，宿主技能面板可直接看到；大纲师、写手、审校、设定管理员按场景自动加载，你不用手动操作：

| 技能 | 一句话说明 |
|---|---|
| maoying-golden-opening | 黄金三章：前三章职能分工（世界钩子 → 动机确立 → 冲突引爆）、前 300 字出事原则、信息释放纪律与自检清单 |
| maoying-beat-pacing | 爽点节奏：爽点类型库、压抑-释放配比、单章/中/大三级节奏曲线与章尾钩子选型 |
| maoying-review-checklist | 审校清单：语言/节奏/人设/逻辑/伏笔/剧透六层逐项检查，按 P0/P1/P2 三档严重度输出 |
| maoying-foreshadow-discipline | 伏笔管理：埋设即登记、推进节奏排期、回收「意外 + 合理」标准与台账清理阈值 |

安装器只认 `maoying-*` 前缀目录，`~/.dsh/skills/` 下你自己的技能一个字节不动。卸载插件后技能目录需手动清理（四目录一起删）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

## novel/ 数据规范

`novel/` 目录是整个插件的数据库：project.yml（元信息与七阶段 phase）、volumes.yml、chapters/（frontmatter 五维叙事字段 + 正文）、characters/（角色卡）、world/、science/（三色设定）、relations.yml、foreshadows.yml（伏笔状态机）、timeline.yml、memories.yml（含出场记录与承诺账）、clue-board.yml、research/、exports/。全部格式、示例与设计理由见：

- 速查版：项目初始化后的 `novel/README.md`（模板源 [templates/novel/README.md](templates/novel/README.md)）
- 完整版：[docs/spec.md](docs/spec.md)（为什么不用 SQLite、五维字段定义、伏笔状态机语义、出场记录约定）

## CLI

```bash
maoying init [dir]     # 生成 novel/ 脚手架（默认 ./novel；已存在文件一律跳过，绝不覆盖）
maoying stats [dir]    # 逐章 CJK 字数、状态分布、当前 phase
maoying index [dir]    # 从 volumes.yml + chapters/ 重建 index.yml（派生文件）
maoying export [dir]   # 导出全书：--format md|txt|epub（默认 md），--out <目录> 改输出位置
```

export 示例：

```bash
maoying export novel                      # Markdown，落到 novel/exports/
maoying export novel --format txt         # 纯文本
maoying export novel --format epub        # EPUB 3（零依赖打包，可直接导入阅读器）
maoying export novel --format epub --out ~/Downloads   # 换输出目录
```

输出目录默认 `<dir>/exports/`，文件名 `<书名>-<YYYYMMDD>.<扩展名>`（书名取 project.yml 的 title）；章节解析与 stats/index 同一套逻辑，frontmatter 不会混进正文。

零依赖（node:fs/path/url/crypto），任意 cwd 可用。装法三选一：`npm install -g dsh-maoying`、随用随取的 `npx maoying <命令>`、或开发机的 `npm link`（仓库检出即改即生效）。三样都没有时 `node <插件目录>/bin/maoying.mjs` 等价（dsh 插件安装也会把包落进 profile，可直接指过去）。日常写作中 index.yml 由设定管理员直接重建，CLI 主要给人用。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-maoying
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/.agent-presets/maoying"
rm -rf "${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}/skills/"maoying-*
```

宿主是 DSH 0.1.7+ 时再补一步：删去 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 里的 dsh-maoying 托管块（`# --- dsh-maoying preset managed (auto-generated; do not edit) ---` 到 `# --- end dsh-maoying preset managed ---` 之间的整段，含两行标记），免得留下指向已删目录的声明行。`novel/` 目录是你的书稿，卸载插件不会动它。

## 兼容面

插件启动时读宿主版本（`<home>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/package.json`），按版本自动选择委派行形状——**宿主升级后重启即切换，无需重装插件**：

- **DSH 0.1.7 – 0.2.1-rc.1 → v1 内联形状**：5 个角色委派行直接内联 persona 与 toolFilter，托管块 1 条声明行。
- **DSH 0.2.1-rc.2+ → v2 AgentPreset 形状**：该版本起 dsh-tool-subagent 拒绝内联 persona/toolFilter，插件改用 [presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml](presets/maoying/agent.cordis.v2.yml)——托管块写 6 条声明行（主编 preset + 大纲师/写手/审校/设定管理员/素材调研员 5 张角色 preset），主编委派行以 `agentPreset` 指向角色 preset，角色的工具面由 preset 里的实体工具行承载（审校只读、考据带联网检索）。
- **角色预设会出现在预设选择器**（宿主对预设没有隐藏机制），name 带「（内部）」标明：日常写作由主编委派自动选用，不经主编、想单独开一个写手/考据会话时直接选中即可。
- 两种形状的 persona 文本同源逐字一致（[test/composition.test.mjs](test/composition.test.mjs) 逐字节把关）；宿主版本读不到时保守按 v1 处理。
- ≤0.1.6 的目录扫描轨道：不做（宿主已淘汰）。

## 许可

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 lifangjin

## 致谢

- 「毛颖」得名于韩愈《毛颖传》：毛笔拟人，有封地有爵位。

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: out-of-band progress narration for the Web UI and dsh-tui
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-progress-summary

[![test](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary/actions/workflows/test.yml)

Out-of-band progress narration for DeepSeek Harness: a cheap auxiliary model turns the live
chain of thought into one short status line, shown above the composer in the Web UI and on the
dsh-tui status line.

## Where it shows

- **Web**: the row above the composer (the input dock), not the transcript's process rows.
- **dsh-tui**: the keyed status line above the prompt.
- **Switch**: Settings → General → **Show progress summary**. Turning it off cancels every
  auxiliary call and clears the TUI row immediately.
- Other knobs (model, interval, token floor, language) live on the plugin's page in Plugins.

The transcript's four work-details modes are untouched; this plugin does not add a fifth mode.

## Why out-of-band

Codex-style progress text comes from a model-side channel (`reasoning.summary` plus `commentary`
messages). DeepSeek exposes only raw `reasoning_content`, so there are two ways to approximate it:

- **Prompt nudging** (what the existing working-activity / progress-narrator plugins do): ask the
  main model to narrate each step. Cheap, but it competes with the task for output budget, and
  OpenAI's own Codex migration guide recommends removing exactly this kind of preamble prompt.
- **Out-of-band narration** (this plugin): the main model is untouched; a second, tiny request
  reads the recent reasoning and writes one line.

The cost is an extra call; the benefit is that the task never competes with its own status text.

## Trigger policy

Two layers: **free lines** update at every boundary, **model lines** fire only before a tool call.

| Trigger | Output | Cost |
|---|---|---|
| Turn start (opt-in) | "Analyzing the request" | 0 |
| Every tool call (opt-in) | a line derived from the tool name and arguments | 0 |
| **Before a tool call**, with both floors met | one sentence from the auxiliary model | 1 call |
| Turn end | idle, clearing both surfaces | 0 |

The model line requires both:

1. **Time**: at least `minIntervalMs` since the last model line (default 20s).
2. **Tokens**: at least `minTokens` of new reasoning since then (default 600; `charsPerToken`
   defaults to 3, so roughly 1800 characters).

A tool call is the only trigger that starts a model line because it is the one point where the
preceding chain of thought is known to be complete: the model has committed to an action. A pause
in the stream proves nothing (network jitter, a provider that emits two tokens and stalls, ordinary
tokenization gaps), which is why there is no timer-based trigger.

Below either floor the material stays buffered and the next tool boundary re-checks. A failed call
returns the consumed characters and retries at the next boundary. Turns without tool calls get no
model line at all — a deliberate trade: rather than cut into a reasoning block, stay quiet.

The two free rows are off by default (`quickLines: false`): the dock is a summary surface, not a
second command log. The prompt also forbids naming tools, commands, or paths, because the
transcript already shows every call.

Caps: `maxPerTurn` (default 40) calls per turn, 96 output tokens per call, `effort=off`.

## Install

### From a git tag (no registry needed)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add "github:tastynoob/dsh-progress-summary#v0.1.0"   # optional
```

`dsh plugin add` forwards the spec to pnpm, so any pnpm git form works:
`github:user/repo#tag`, `git+https://github.com/user/repo.git#tag`, or the plain
`https://github.com/user/repo#tag`. The tag pins the version; the package has no build step, so
pnpm clones it and installs its dependencies from the registry.

### From npm (once published)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-progress-summary
dsh plugin --profile dsh-tui add dsh-progress-summary   # optional: TUI
```

The package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so `dsh plugin add` appends it to the profile's bundle
list; `cordis.patch.yml` inserts the `progress-summary` row and `dsh.client` makes the Web client
load the browser half. Dependencies (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`, `dsh-llm`, `schemastery`) are
installed into the profile by pnpm.

Remove with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-progress-summary`.

### Local development (`link:`)

```bash
npm install --omit=dev
dsh plugin --profile web add "link:$PWD"
```

`link:` is a development convenience: the profile holds a symlink, so a source edit plus a restart
is enough. It has no bearing on publishing.

## Configuration

| Key | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | Master switch; also the Settings toggle (live) |
| `provider` / `model` | `auto` | `auto` follows the session's own route; otherwise pin a route |
| `effort` | `off` | Reasoning effort for the auxiliary call |
| `maxTokens` | `96` | Output cap for one line |
| `timeoutMs` | `8000` | Abort a single call after this long |
| `minIntervalMs` | `20000` | Time floor between two model lines (live) |
| `minTokens` | `600` | Token floor at a tool boundary (live) |
| `charsPerToken` | `3` | Divisor used for the token estimate |
| `excerptChars` | `700` | Reasoning tail sent to the model |
| `maxLineChars` | `128` | Hard cap for the rendered line (characters) |
| `maxPerTurn` | `40` | Hard cap on auxiliary calls per turn (live) |
| `lang` | `auto` | `auto` follows the host locale; `zh` / `en` pin it |
| `publish` | `true` | Commit ignorable records so the Web UI receives lines |
| `tui` | `true` | Contribute the line to a composed TUI |
| `quickLines` | `false` | Opt into the free turn-start/per-tool lines |
| `subagents` | `false` | Narrate subagent sessions too |
| `debug` | `true` | Append a bounded diagnostics log under `~/.dsh/` |

Fields marked live are volatile: a save takes effect on the next tool boundary, without a restart.

## How each surface receives the line

- **Web**: the host commits `plugin:progress-summary/line` (an ignorable record, safe for resume),
  which folds into the `progressSummary` session projection. The browser reads it with
  `useProjection`; nothing is written to the model-visible history.
- **dsh-tui**: `ctx.tuiStatus.set('progress-summary', line)`, cleared at turn end. This path does
  not need the record at all.

Both profiles load the same package; only the available services differ.

## Implementation notes

- Records are committed from a microtask: `session/event` listeners run inside the session's own
  commit, where a second append is refused as re-entrant.
- The commit function is taken from the Loader entry for `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`
  (`entry.moduleNamespace`), because path-resolved copies are separate ESM instances whose private
  `Session` brand does not match the live session objects.
- The auxiliary route defaults to the session's logged `request/header` route, so no separate
  credentials or model catalog entry is needed.
- A process that starts mid-turn (a restart while a turn is running) adopts that turn at the first
  tool boundary instead of staying silent until the next turn.

## Known limitations

- One ignorable record is committed per published line (roughly 10–20 per turn at the defaults);
  set `publish: false` to keep the log clean, at the cost of the Web line.
- Turns with no tool call produce no model line.
- The line is capped at 128 characters and rendered on at most two lines.
- A misconfigured provider/model fails silently; the UI simply has no line.

## Tests

```bash
npm test      # node --test, 35 cases
npm run check # syntax check of every runtime file
```

plugins.description: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop UI: search the conversation and the right panel, highlight matches, and jump between results. As-is / best-effort.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-anywhere

为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness  提供 `Ctrl+F` 式查找：在**当前对话**和**右侧面板**中搜索已渲染文本，高亮全部匹配，并在结果间循环定位。

包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-find-anywhere`，版本 `0.1.0`，纯浏览器实现。

> **发布状态：as-is / best-effort。** 本仓库按现状发布，不承诺持续维护、不承诺跟进上游变更，也不承诺及时响应 issue。详见 [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md)。

## 为什么值得用：右侧面板内容也能搜

右侧面板常驻文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等信息。多数查找只覆盖对话正文；本插件把**右侧面板当前激活页里已渲染的文字**纳入同一套查找条：

- 面板打开时，右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮，点击即可查找面板内容。
- `Ctrl+Shift+F` 直接进入右侧面板范围。
- 查找条停靠在面板内容区顶部，避开标签栏和文件路径行，并随面板展开/全屏/切换标签重新定位。
- 对话和右侧面板共享高亮、计数、上一个/下一个循环；范围随时切换。

查找条只读取 DOM 文本，不修改面板结构，也不发送内容到网络。

## 使用

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开查找条；焦点在右侧面板时搜索面板，否则搜索对话 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 打开右侧面板范围 |
| 对话标题栏的 🔍 / 右侧面板右下角的 🔍 | 鼠标打开对应范围 |
| 输入文字 | 实时高亮全部匹配，计数显示 `当前/总数` |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl+G` | 下一个匹配（循环） |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` / `Ctrl+Shift+G` | 上一个匹配（循环） |
| 计数旁 `↑` / `↓` | 上一个 / 下一个 |
| 查找条左侧的范围切换 | 在对话与右侧面板之间切换 |
| `Esc` | 关闭并清除高亮 |

### 范围规则

- **对话**：搜索当前对话列里已渲染的文字（用户消息、助手回复、工具卡片、命令输出等）；输入框和编辑器被排除，草稿不会产生假匹配。
- **右侧面板**：搜索当前激活页里已渲染的文字（文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等）；面板标签栏、按钮和工具栏文字被排除。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 面板关闭时，面板入口自动隐藏；面板重新打开或切换标签后，查找条会重新定位。

## 设计取舍

- **不包裹 `<mark>`**：对话 DOM 归 React 所有，流式输出时持续重渲染。插件使用 CSS Custom Highlight API 在 Range 上绘制高亮，不插入节点，不破坏 reconciliation。
- **MutationObserver 跟随流式输出**：对话继续输出或历史分页载入时防抖重算匹配；按“文本节点 + 偏移”保持当前匹配，不会跳到另一个位置。
- **纯 DOM 检索**：不依赖会话数据结构，因此工具卡片、命令输出、折叠内容中已渲染的部分都能被找到；尚未进入 DOM 的虚拟化历史不在范围内。
- **极简外观**：单行 38px 浮条，沿用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，自动适配明暗主题；无结果时计数与边框变红并轻微抖动（尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`）。
- **右侧面板入口**：面板打开时右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮；面板关闭时自动隐藏，不占用面板标签栏的槽位。

## 能力边界

- 只匹配渲染后的纯文本：不做正则、不折叠变音符号、不跨文本节点匹配（被样式拆开的短语可能匹配不到）。
- 依赖 CSS Custom Highlight API（当前 Chromium / Electron 均支持）；不支持时仍能计数和滚动定位，但没有高亮底色。
- 虚拟化或懒加载的历史若尚未进入 DOM，需要先滚动加载后再搜索。
- 右侧面板的**浏览器页签**如果是跨域 iframe，父页面无法读取其内部文字；**终端页签**（canvas/xterm）也没有可检索的 DOM 文本。这两类内容搜不到是预期行为。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 若 `Ctrl+Shift+F` 被其他功能占用，用右侧面板右下角的 🔍，或把焦点放进右侧面板后按 `Ctrl+F`。

## 安装与构建

运行时需要支持客户端插件的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。`lib/` 是注入器实际加载的产物；`src/` 是源码。

```bash
# 仓库是源码形态；先生成运行产物
bash scripts/build.sh
```

若你的环境装有 `dsh-super-injector`，可以把仓库目录注入：

```text
dev_inject_plugin /absolute/path/to/dsh-find-anywhere
```

卸载：

```text
dev_uninject_plugin dsh-find-anywhere
```

也可以直接使用发布包 `dsh-external-dsh-find-anywhere-0.1.0.tgz`。该 tgz 包含 `lib/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、`README.md`、`LICENSE` 和 `MAINTENANCE.md`；具体安装方式取决于你的 DSH 版本。

注意：源码仓库的 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `lib/`，所以 GitHub 上的仓库默认是源码形态；需要预构建产物时请使用 tgz，或本地运行构建脚本。

## 隐私与安全

- 不读取会话数据库，不调用后端接口，不发送任何内容到网络。
- 插件在 DSH Web UI 页面内运行，会读取当前页面已渲染的 DOM 文本。安装前请自行审阅源码。
- 查找高亮使用浏览器原生 Highlight API，不向页面插入额外节点。

## 验证状态

本次发布整理只修改了 `package.json` 元数据与文档，没有重新运行 GUI 验证。功能描述基于现有实现，按 as-is 提供；如果上游 UI 结构变化导致失效，本仓库不承诺修复。

## 文件

- `src/client/index.js` — 全部浏览器逻辑与 UI（ModuleLoader bundle 源文件）
- `src/index.js` — Host 注册壳（无 host 行为）
- `scripts/build.mjs` — 无编译依赖的构建（语法校验 + 复制）
- `lib/` — 注入器实际加载的产物（由 `src/` 生成）
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` — 插件管理页的标题/描述元数据
- `icon.svg` — 原创图标（对话气泡 + 放大镜）
- `LICENSE` — MIT
- `MAINTENANCE.md` — 维护状态与自维护指引

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dsh-find-anywhere contributors

plugins.description: Ephemeral /btw side questions for DeepSeek Harness: full conversation context, no tools, never written to history.
plugins.readme_text:
# @andrewhmir/dsh-btw — ephemeral `/btw` side questions for the DSH Web GUI

An **unofficial community plugin** for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)
(DSH). It adds one gesture to the Web GUI composer:

```
/btw how does the compaction checkpoint interact with the surface?
```

The answer streams into an overlay over the app. Dismissing it leaves **no
trace** in the session: the question and answer are never appended to the
transcript, never rendered as chat rows, and never become part of what the model
sees on the next turn.

It is the inverse of a subagent: a subagent gets the full tool surface and an
empty context; `/btw` gets the full conversation context and no tools.

## What `/btw` does

| property | behavior |
|---|---|
| invocation | `/btw <question>` typed in the composer, mid-session; also selectable from the `/` menu |
| context | the full committed conversation of the current session |
| tools | none — the request carries no tool schemas and no tool history |
| answer | streamed into an overlay over the app frame |
| dismissal | Space, Enter, or Escape (also the close button / backdrop) |
| persistence | none — the exchange never enters session history |
| concurrency | works while the main turn is streaming and never interrupts it |
| shape | single-shot; no follow-up turns |
| model | the session's routed provider/model/reasoning effort |
| cost | one tool-less call whose message prefix is the parent request's prefix, so the provider's prompt cache is reused |

## Requirements

- DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with the Web GUI (`dsh web`).
- Node.js 22 or newer only for the verification scripts; the plugin itself runs
  inside the harness process.

## Install

The package is a DSH **bundle**: it declares `dsh.bundle.patch` and one
client+host plugin row (`id: btw`). Install it into the profile you run, then
restart `dsh web`.

### From a plugin market

Enable DSH's custom plugin market, add a community index that lists this package
(the repository carries the **`dsh-plugin`** GitHub topic so indexes can discover
it), and install `@andrewhmir/dsh-btw` from the Discover tab.

### With the agent

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw@0.1.2
```

### From a local checkout

```
plugin_manager install_bundle  target: /absolute/path/to/dsh-btw
```

### After installing

**Restart `dsh web`.** The running process holds its pre-install module graph;
a restart loads the new host half. Then confirm the composition:

```
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Expected: exit code 0 and a row `id: btw` / `name: @andrewhmir/dsh-btw` with no
`not found`, `unknown key`, or `cannot resolve` lines.

After editing only `client.js`, the harness's client HMR picks the rebuilt file
up on save; host-half edits need a restart.

## How it works

- `ui-commands` claims slash commands that exist in the session's **host**
  command catalog. `/btw` deliberately does not register such a command: a host
  command's result is durably logged (`command/run` / `command/done`) and would
  enter the session history.
- Instead, the plugin's **client half** registers its own `'/'` input-trigger
  source. During composer adjudication it claims `/btw <question>` before any
  host command runs, opens the overlay, and calls the plugin's own loopback
  route `POST /btw/ask`.
- The **host half** resolves the live agent for the session, snapshots the exact
  model-visible history with `Session.deriveMessages()`, appends one frozen user
  message carrying the side question, and runs a single `ctx.llm.stream()` call
  with **no tools, no tool history, and no separate system prompt**. Because the
  message list is the parent request's prefix plus one trailing message, the
  provider's prompt cache is reused.
- The answer streams back as newline-delimited JSON, renders **Markdown** through
  the shell's shared `MarkdownText` component (plain-text fallback if an older
  shell does not seed it), and is shown in a `shell.overlay` panel.
  Space/Enter/Escape abort the request and close it.
- A snapshot taken mid-turn can end with an assistant tool call whose
  `tool/result` is not committed yet. The host trims that trailing unresolved
  step before replaying the history, so `/btw` answers with the conversation as
  of the last completed tool step instead of the provider rejecting the request
  ("tool calls need immediate results").
- Nothing in this path calls `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox — that is what makes the exchange ephemeral.

## Private by design

The ephemerality is a contract, not a rendering choice:

- the question and answer are never written to the session log, so they are not
  in the transcript, the token meter's session history, or any export;
- the host route never touches `session.append`, the command registry, the agent
  loop, or the inbox;
- the only durable effect is provider billing for one call.

It is verified against real session logs: `test/e2e/ephemerality-check.mjs`
decodes every `session.v*.jsonl.zstd` in a test home and fails if the question or
any part of the answer appears in a persisted event. A control run proves the
scanner detects text that *is* legitimately persisted. Results for both supported
harness versions are recorded in [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md).

## Configure

The plugin row accepts two optional values; both have safe defaults and are read
without a Config schema:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: btw
      name: '@andrewhmir/dsh-btw'
      config:
        maxTokens: 1200    # completion cap for one side answer (default 1200)
        timeoutMs: 120000  # hard deadline for one side call (default 120000)
```

Questions are capped at 4000 characters; the request body is capped at 32 KiB.

## Known limitations

- **In-flight partial assistant text is not included.** The snapshot reads the
  committed session surface; while the main turn is streaming, the current
  assistant message is not committed yet. `/btw` sees the conversation as of the
  last committed event.
- **Not visible in session-log cost dashboards.** Ephemeral calls leave no
  session-log trace; provider billing is the source of truth for them.
- **Web GUI only.** The host route is generic, but the invocation and overlay are
  client-side Web features.
- **English overlay copy.** Display metadata ships in English and Chinese;
  in-overlay strings are English in this version.
- **A future host `btw` command would shadow this plugin.** The host catalog is
  adjudicated before the plugin's source; if a future harness version ships a
  host command with the same name, `/btw` would execute that command instead.
- **Single-shot.** There is no follow-up turn inside the overlay.

## Compatibility

`engines.dsh` declares `>=0.2.0-rc.2`. Both tags were verified on a clean-room
install containing only the official bundles plus this plugin:

| Harness | Result |
|---|---|
| `0.2.0-rc.2` (npm `latest`) | overlay + streamed answer, uppercase `/BTW`, Markdown, Escape/Space/Enter dismissal, warm cache |
| `0.2.1-rc.2` (npm `next`) | the above, plus mid-stream concurrency (4/4 answers during a tool call) and strict ephemerality |

See [`docs/VERIFICATION.md`](docs/VERIFICATION.md) for the measurements and the
exact commands.

## Verify

From this directory:

```
node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
node tools/build-client.mjs --check
node --check client.js
```

The clean-room and browser harness lives in `test/e2e/` and is documented there.
It is not shipped in the published package:

- `clean-room.ps1` builds a fresh DSH home with only the official bundles plus
  this plugin, seeds the workspace state, composes, boots, and prints the URL;
- `first-run.mjs` dismisses the first-run preview notice and proves the composer
  accepts text;
- `cdp-e2e.mjs` drives the real GUI over the DevTools protocol (`probe`, `full`,
  `dismiss-keys`, `mid-stream`);
- `ephemerality-check.mjs` asserts that no exchange reached a session log.

## Development

```
node tools/build-client.mjs         # regenerate client.js from src/client/*.mjs
node tools/build-client.mjs --check # fail when client.js is stale
node --

plugins.description: Transparent draggable performance HUD for DeepSeek Harness - CPU, GPU and memory usage plus CPU/GPU temperatures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud

A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness web UI:
**CPU / GPU / memory usage**, plus the **CPU package temperature** when the
optional helper is installed.

![dsh-perf-hud floating over the Harness window](docs/preview.png)

## Highlights

- **Fully transparent** — no card background, no border. Just three rows of text
  floating over the interface, with a soft halo so it stays readable on any
  content.
- **Drag it anywhere.** On release it anchors to the nearest window corner, so
  maximising, restoring or resizing the window keeps it exactly where you put
  it. Double-click resets to the top-right, arrow keys nudge it, and the chevron
  that appears on hover collapses it to a single row.
- **Load-aware colours** — usage turns amber at 70% and red at 90%; temperature
  at 78 °C / 88 °C. Stale readings dim the whole card instead of flashing a fake
  zero.
- **Theme-aware** — only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so it follows light, dark and
  any custom theme.
- **Local only** — the metrics route answers loopback, same-origin requests and
  returns 403 for everything else. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The GPU counters, the PowerShell worker and the temperature
  helper are Windows-specific.
- DeepSeek Harness with the web UI.

## Install

From the Plugins page (install from GitHub or a local folder), or:

```sh
dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
```

Then reload the interface once.

## What it reads

| Metric | Source |
| --- | --- |
| CPU usage | `node:os` CPU-time deltas, once a second |
| Memory usage | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` — same definition as Task Manager's "In use" |
| GPU usage | Windows `GPU Engine` performance counters, busiest engine (what Task Manager reports) |
| CPU temperature | optional helper — LibreHardwareMonitor's `CPU Package` sensor |
| GPU temperature | only when the GPU exposes a temperature sensor; most integrated GPUs do not, so the cell shows `—` |

## Temperatures (optional)

The plugin works out of the box; without the helper both temperature cells show
`—`. For the real CPU package temperature, run **once** (it asks for
administrator rights):

```
helper\setup.cmd
```

That script downloads and sets up:

- **LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6** (portable, library only) — reads the sensors;
- **PawnIO 2.2.0**, a signed kernel driver — required to read MSRs while Windows
  "Memory integrity" (HVCI) stays enabled, so you do **not** have to weaken that
  setting;
- **`sensor-helper.ps1`**, which writes one small JSON file about every 0.4 s;
- a scheduled task **`DSH Perf Sensor`** (at logon, highest privileges, no
  window), so it never asks again.

Files go to `D:\DSHTools` when that drive exists, otherwise
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSHTools`. The plugin reads either location.

Measured overhead on an 8-core laptop: **0.08 % of one core and ~87 MB of RAM**
for the helper — it is mostly waiting on the driver, not burning CPU.

Remove it again with:

```
helper\uninstall.ps1              # stops the task, uninstalls the driver
helper\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveFiles # ...and deletes the helper files
```

## Limitations

- Windows only.
- GPU temperatures need a dedicated sensor; Intel integrated GPUs do not expose
  one, and the CPU package temperature is the closest reference (same die).
- The card floats **inside the Harness window**, not as a separate
  always-on-top desktop window.

## 中文说明

DeepSeek Harness 界面里的一块完全透明的性能读数：CPU / GPU / 内存占用率，加上
CPU 封装温度。没有底色和边框，只有三行文字浮在界面上。

- **拖动**卡片任意位置移动，松手后吸附到最近的窗口角，窗口最大化 / 还原 / 改变
  大小都保持位置；**双击**回到右上角，方向键微调，悬停右侧箭头可收起成一行。
- 占用率 ≥70% 变琥珀、≥90% 变红；温度 ≥78 °C / ≥88 °C 同理；读数过期整卡变暗。
- 安装：插件页面安装本仓库，或 `dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud`。
- 温度需要可选助手：管理员运行一次 `helper\setup.cmd`（会安装 LibreHardwareMonitor
  与 PawnIO 签名驱动，并注册开机自启任务）。不需要时用 `helper\uninstall.ps1` 移除。
- 没有温度助手时温度一栏显示 `—`；Intel 核显本身没有独立温度传感器，同样显示 `—`。
- 仅支持 Windows；悬浮窗在 Harness 窗口内部，不是独立的桌面置顶窗口。

## License

[MIT](LICENSE)
