plugins.description: Give the whole left column back to the conversation on narrow screens: below 1024px the DSH sidebar leaves the frame entirely and a header button opens it as an overlay drawer.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-mobile-sidebar

Give the whole left column back to the conversation on phones.

## What it changes

Below **1024px** — the same breakpoint at which `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`
auto-collapses the sidebar — the stock web shell still keeps a **56px icon rail**
(`computeColumns()` resolves the collapsed track to `collapsedWidth`, which is 56 on
the web; only macOS desktop and the Windows titlebar shell pass 0). On a 390px
viewport that rail eats 14% of the screen for a column you cannot read anything in.

This plugin, under the same breakpoint:

| | stock | with the plugin |
|---|---|---|
| frame tracks at 390px | `56px 334px 0px` | `0px 390px 0px` |
| collapsed sidebar | 56px icon rail | nothing — no track, no paint |
| opening the sidebar | squeezes the centre to 110px | 300px drawer over a 390px centre, tap outside to close |
| header | no toggle | panel-left button at the header's leading edge |
| ≥ 1024px | — | untouched (`280px 1000px 0px`, button hidden) |

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add file:/path/to/dsh-mobile-sidebar
```

`dsh plugin add` appends the package to `dsh.profile.bundles` and hot-mounts it;
the browser only needs a **refresh** to load the new client combo. No `dsh web`
restart is required.

To remove it, delete the `"dsh-mobile-sidebar"` entry from `bundles` in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/package.json`, or disable the bundle from the Plugins
page.

## How it works

Everything is browser-side; the Host half is intentionally empty.

1. **Zero the sidebar track.** React writes `grid-template-columns` as an inline
   style, and a media query cannot override one track of it. A `MutationObserver`
   on the frame watches every solve, rewrites the value with **only the first
   track** replaced, and republishes it through the
   `--dsh-mobile-frame-cols` custom property. The centre and right tracks still
   matter between 800px and 1024px, where the right panel solves a real third
   track, so they are carried through untouched.
2. **Hide the rail without leaving the grid.** `visibility: hidden`, *not*
   `display: none`. A `display:none` box is not a grid item, so auto-placement
   slides the centre column into the now-0px first track and the conversation
   renders at zero width.
3. **Open as a drawer.** The column stays a grid item in its 0px track and simply
   overflows it (`position: relative` + an explicit width), so the centre column
   never changes width. A scrim in the `shell.overlay` slot closes it on tap.
4. **The toggle.** On the Conversation it is a primitives `Button` +
   `IconPanelLeftOutlineRegular` in the `conversation.header.leading` slot, calling
   `ctx.layout.toggleSidebar()`.

## Global panels (Plugins, Automation tasks, …)

The Conversation is the **only** panel that declares a header slot. Every other
global panel registers into the keyed `main` slot and builds its own heading —
Plugins renders `<header class="…pageHead">`, Schedules renders
`<div class="…pageHeading">`, and neither exposes anything to inject into.

So the toggle falls back to a fixed control rendered in `shell.overlay`, which
the shell always mounts at root scope. That covers every panel at once, including
panels that do not exist yet. Two rules keep it honest:

- **It steps aside on the Conversation.** `[frame]:not(:has([data-dsh-mobile-sidebar-button]))`
  is what hides it there, so the in-header button and the floating one never
  appear together.
- **It reserves its own lane.** Panel headings all start 28px down and 24px in,
  so the control would sit on the title's shoulder; a rule adds 40px of
  `padding-inline-start` to those headings while the control is present.

| where | control |
|---|---|
| Conversation | `conversation.header.leading` slot |
| Plugins / Schedules / any future panel | fixed control in `shell.overlay` |
| ≥ 1024px | neither |

## Screenshots

Closed on a phone — the rail is gone and the conversation keeps the full width:

![Mobile with the sidebar closed](docs/mobile-sidebar-hidden.png)

Tapping the header toggle opens the drawer over that same full-width conversation:

![Sidebar open as a drawer](docs/mobile-sidebar-drawer.png)

On a global panel the toggle falls back to a fixed control:

![Toggle fallback on the Plugins panel](docs/mobile-panel-toggle.png)

Above the breakpoint nothing changes:

![Desktop layout unchanged](docs/desktop-unchanged.png)

## Upgrades

The plugin targets source-written attributes, not the shell's CSS-module class
names (which are build-hashed and change between DSH releases):

- `[data-shell-overlay]` — the frame is its parent element
- `[data-slot="sidebar"]` — the sidebar column is its parent element
- `[data-sidebar-collapsed]` on the frame — closed vs. open
- `[data-plugin-panel]` — the one global panel that marks its section; the rest
  are matched on the `_pageHead` / `_pageHeading` class fragment

## License

MIT

plugins.readme_text:
# 📦 @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider

OpenCode Console & OpenCode Go LLM Provider for DeepSeek Harness

⭐ If you like this plugin, please star it on GitHub — it shows me that the plugin is useful to you and motivates me to keep developing it.

🐛 If you find a bug or would like to request a feature, open a GitHub issue in any language — I will review your proposal and implement useful suggestions in a future plugin version.
--- OpenCode / OpenCode Go provider plugin for [DeepSeek Harness](https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/) (dsh). It registers two native LLM routes: | Route | Product | Base | |---|---|---| | `opencode` | OpenCode Console / Zen (pay-as-you-go) | `https://opencode.ai/inference` | | `opencode-go` | OpenCode Go / Go Plus subscription | `https://opencode.ai/inference/go` | Requests resolve the key per call, so a changed credential reaches the next request without a restart. ## Architecture ```mermaid graph LR subgraph DSH["DeepSeek Harness Core"] Agent["DSH Agent / Chat"] Creds["Credentials / auth.json"] end subgraph Plugin["dsh-opencode-provider"] Router{"Route Selector"} Pool["Multi-Account Pool
(Auto-Rotation & Cooldowns)"] Heatmap["Heatmap & Quota Telemetry
(5h / Week / Month)"] subgraph Transports["4 Wire Transports"] T1["OpenAI Chat"] T2["Anthropic Messages
(Thinking Signatures)"] T3["OpenAI Responses"] T4["Google GenAI
(thoughtSignature Replay)"] end end subgraph OpenCode["OpenCode Gateway"] Console["opencode (Console / Zen)"] Go["opencode-go (Go / Go Plus)"] end Agent --> Router Creds -.-> Pool Router -->|opencode| Pool Router -->|opencode-go| Pool Pool --> Heatmap Pool --> Transports T1 & T2 & T3 & T4 --> Console & Go ``` ## What works - **Four wire transports**, chosen per model: - OpenAI Chat Completions (DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, MiMo, LongCat, Hy3, Step, …). - Anthropic Messages (Claude Haiku, MiniMax, Qwen). - OpenAI Responses (GPT, Grok, Muse). - Google Generative AI (Gemini). - **Text, reasoning, streamed tool calls, usage, finish reasons.** - **Images** through the durable attachment service, rendered natively per transport. - **Replay of provider metadata** where the endpoint requires it: - Anthropic thinking signatures. - Gemini `thoughtSignature` on historical function calls. - **Multi-account rotation** before a stream starts: 401/403/429 and quota/usage-limit bodies (400/402/403/429). An invalid key cools down for 24h, a quota rejection for 10 minutes or `Retry-After`, a rate limit for 60s or `Retry-After`. A request already streaming is never replayed on another account; the next request uses the next usable key. - **Per-account quotas**: each account row shows its own 5-hour / weekly / monthly usage, the active account drives the sidebar and quota panel, and the panel lists every account side by side. - **Model → account rules**: first matching glob pins a preferred account for that model; the other accounts remain fallbacks if it fails or is cooling. - **Request heatmap** in the quota panel: a Monday-first weekday × hour grid in local time, plus a 24-hour aggregate strip underneath. A selector switches between all requests and any single model. The adapter appends `{at, provider, model, purpose?}` to `~/.dsh/storages/dsh-opencode/requests.jsonl`; no prompt, response or key is stored. Auxiliary `session-title`/`compaction` calls are excluded from the heatmap and exact duplicate records collapse. The log compacts at 2 MB to the newest 5000 lines. Collection starts with this build — the projection cache only has `lastPromptAt`, not per-request timestamps. - **Stable `x-opencode-session`** derived from the durable session id, so retries and every turn of a conversation reuse the same routing key. - **Live catalog** from `/v1/models` with a generated `models.dev` fallback. - **Per-model subscription limits** from the OpenCode Go pricing table: monthly dollar allowance plus estimated requests for the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows, for both Go and Go Plus. Shown in the model picker and the settings page; estimates only — the gateway remains the authority. - **`/opencode` command** for status, usage, accounts, models, rules, and `test [model]`. - **TUI settings section** for the terminal profile (`/settings → OpenCode`) with the key, endpoints, allowlist, active account and timeouts. - **One-click plugin update** in Settings → OpenCode: current/latest version, an update badge, and an **Update now** button that installs the exact npm version through the DSH CLI and asks for a restart. The host endpoint is `GET/POST /dsh-opencode/update`. - **Plan-aware Go picker**: hides models outside the Go table unless turned off; descriptions carry `Go`, `Console` or `FREE`. - **Request-wide image budget** (newest images win, oldest become an omitted placeholder) and **object-root tool-schema normalization** for MCP/third-party tools. - **Usage analytics dashboard** in the quota panel: KPI cards (requests, tokens, success, input/output, reasoning, cache, TTFT, latency, errors), a 7/30/90 selector, and Models / Days / Sessions tables. Success and error cards show `—`: the local projection does not expose failed attempts or reasoning tokens. - **Usage by model** from the local session projection cache: sessions and tokens per OpenCode model. Only numeric metadata is read; titles and message content stay local. - **Browser UI**: - **Settings → OpenCode**: key status, paste/import/clear, quota bars, accounts, model allowlist, per-model transport overrides, connection settings. - **Sidebar quota card** (off by default): a ring with the active account and the highest window, then 5-hour / weekly / monthly rows with remaining quota, reset countdown and bars; clicking opens the full quota panel in the center column. The panel scrolls internally, so the heatmap and usage table below the fold stay reachable. - **Cost** is shown only by DSH's native cost display; the plugin does not add a second composer pill. - Model price badges in the settings page; the OpenCode auth-entry field autocompletes from `auth.json`. - Host routes under `/dsh-opencode/*` serve state and accept writes only from a loopback Host with same-origin and JSON checks; `GET /dsh-opencode/health` reports provider registration, accounts and model count. - The provider keeps core harness tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `bash`, `glob`, `grep`, …) when a large MCP set is trimmed to OpenCode's 128-tool limit. ## Install Build and pack first: ```bash npm install npm run build npm pack ``` Install the **packed tarball** into a profile: ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-opencode-provider-0.5.1.tgz # DSH Desktop: dsh plugin --profile desktop add /absolute/path/to/goodandready-dsh-opencode-provider-0.5.1.tgz # Or install the published package: dsh plugin --profile web add @goodandready/dsh-opencode-provider@0.5.1 ``` Restart dsh (or DSH Desktop), then pick `OpenCode` or `OpenCode Go` in the model picker. > **Use the tarball, not the directory.** On dsh 0.2.1-rc.2 the Desktop CLI aliases a local > directory passed to `dsh plugin add` as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-runtime` and overwrites > the target's `package.jso

plugins.description: Auto-recovery for DeepSeek Harness: continues turns that ended abnormally or were swallowed into plain text, and revives stalled model requests.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-unstuck

给 DeepSeek Harness 用的**监督员**插件。dsh 跑着跑着自己断了、卡住了、闷头不动了，它负责发现并把你解开（`unstuck`），不需要你手动发消息。

> **English** — A watchdog plugin for DeepSeek Harness. When a run stops on its own and waits for you to say something, this continues it.
>
> It handles three cases, and nothing else:
> - **Abnormal turn end** (`error`, `aborted` not caused by you, `max-tokens`, `interrupted`) — sends one "continue" after a short delay.
> - **Swallowed turns** — the turn is logged as `completed` even though the model meant to call a tool and an OpenAI-compatible relay emitted the call markup as plain text instead, leaving the agent silently idle. Detected structurally (the reasoning block and the text block are byte-identical, or the text is empty while reasoning is not, or the tail is a broken call tag) and continued with a pointed message asking for the tool call again.
> - **Stalled requests** — a model request was issued and then no stream frame arrived for `stallMs`. The turn is cancelled (`kind: 'hook'`, inbox kept) and continued.
>
> Waiting on an approval or on a question is logged and notified, never answered on your behalf. A stop you pressed yourself, a turn that really finished, and non-retryable errors (auth, quota, context overflow) are all left alone. Detection is pure structure over the session log — no judge model, no network calls.
>
> Install: `dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck` (or run `install.ps1` from a local clone). Config: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/config.json`. Log: `<DSH_HOME>/unstuck/unstuck.jsonl`. The detailed documentation below is in Chinese; `PLUGIN-NOTES.md` records why each decision was made.

---

## 它管三件事

| 现象 | 监督员怎么做 |
| --- | --- |
| 一轮对话异常结束（上游报错、输出被截断、进程崩溃留下的残局、非你按的中断） | 等一小会儿，补发一条「继续」 |
| **「假完成」**：日志写着这轮正常结束，其实工具调用被吞了、活没干完（最常见，见下节） | 补一条带指向性的「继续」，让它重新发工具调用 |
| 模型请求发出去了，但很久**没有任何流片段**（假死：TCP 断了但不报错） | 掐掉当前这一轮，再补「继续」 |
| 卡在等你审批 / 等你回答问题 | 只记录 + 通知，**绝不替你回答** |

不插手的情况：你按了停止、你这轮真的干完了、你正在输入（inbox 里有你的消息）、连续中断超过预算、认证失败这类再试也没用的错误。

「异常结束」具体指这几种 `turn/end` 原因：`error`（上游报错）、`aborted`（不是你按的停止）、`max-tokens`（输出被 token 上限截断）、`interrupted`（进程中断留下的残局）。

---

## 断连根因：中转站把工具调用吞成了正文

这不是猜的，是从真实会话日志里挖出来的。同一会话三轮，**每一轮都是这么断的**：

| turn | 末 step | 耗时 | 块结构 | reasoning 与 text | tool-call | 正文尾部 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | 21 | 10.6s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…</｜｜DSML｜｜ calls>` |
| 2 | 138 | 4.5s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `…temp dir.</｜｜DSML｜｜ parameter>` |
| 3 | 10 | 18.4s | reasoning+text | **逐字节相同** | 无 | `Hmm, the`（断在词中间） |

同一会话 172 条 assistant 消息里，「reasoning 和 text 逐字节相同且没有 tool-call」只出现这 3 次 —— 正是被吞的 3 次，其余 169 条零误报。

**机理**：模型本来要发工具调用，中转站（`api: openai-completions` 兼容层）没能把 DeepSeek 原生的 `｜｜DSML｜｜` 工具调用标记转成 OpenAI 的 `tool_calls`，那段标记被当普通正文吐了出来。于是 assistant 消息里只剩 reasoning + text、没有 tool-call；agent 循环认为「模型没要求调工具 = 这轮说完了」，`turn/end` 记成 `completed`，agent 静默 idle。

你看到的现象就是「跑着跑着自己断了，得手动发一句才继续」。耗时正常（4.5–18.4s，不是超时）、长度不一（2868–8892 字符，不是 token 上限），所以既不是超时也不是截断，是**协议转换层偶发失败**。

dsh 自带的「继续」按钮也救不了它 —— 那个按钮把 `completed` 当「已收工」，直接拒绝续跑。本插件的 `continueOnSwallowed` 就是专门补这个洞。

### 想根治的话（可选）

根因在中转站那一层，插件只能兜底。能减轻的办法：

- **换模型**：`glm-5.3` / `kimi-k3-1` / `minimax-m3` 这些模型原生就是 OpenAI 风格的工具调用，不走 DSML，理论上不会踩这个坑。改 profile 的 `agent-default-model` 即可。
- **降 `reasoningEffort`**：`max` 会让 reasoning 特别长，长流更容易在中转站出错。降到 `high` 试试。
- **换官方端点**：DeepSeek 官方 API 不会有这层转换。

---

## 三个必须知道的默认行为

1. **只补「继续」两个字。** 它不猜你想干什么，也不改你的需求。续跑消息的来源标记是 `dsh-unstuck`，所以它不会把自己发的消息当成你在说话。
2. **有预算。** 同一个会话连续中断最多自动续跑 `continueMax`（默认 3）次，用完就停手并在日志里记一条 `continue-budget-exhausted`。你只要手动发一条消息，预算立刻清零。
3. **有退避。** 第 1/2/3 次续跑前分别多等 1.5s / 5s / 15s，避免把上游打爆、也避免烧钱。

---

## 安装

两种装法。只想装上用走第一种；要改代码或者离线装走第二种。

### 一、从 GitHub 装（推荐）

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile tauri add github:Chlyz621/dsh-unstuck
```

dsh 会把仓库取到 profile 的 `node_modules` 下并登记进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

### 二、从本地目录装（改代码时用）

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
pwsh -File .\install.ps1
```

装完**完全退出** DeepSeek Harness（含托盘图标）再打开。

脚本做三件事，每一步都会先备份：

1. 把插件复制到 `<DSH_HOME>\plugins\dsh-unstuck`
2. 在 `<DSH_HOME>\profiles\tauri\package.json` 里登记依赖并加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`
3. 在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下建一个目录联接，让 dsh 能 `require` 到它（不联网、不跑 pnpm）

参数：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\install.ps1 -Profile tauri -DshHome C:\Users\me\.dsh -Force
```

卸载：

```powershell
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1          # 只从 profile 摘掉，插件文件留着
pwsh -File .\uninstall.ps1 -Purge  # 连插件文件一起删
```

---

## 怎么确认它活着

```powershell
Get-Content "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\unstuck.jsonl" -Tail 20
```

开机应该有一行 `{"event":"boot",...}`，里面能看到当前生效的配置和挂上了几个监听器。之后每次动手都有记录：

| event | 含义 |
| --- | --- |
| `boot` / `dispose` | 装上了 / 卸载了 |
| `continue-sent` | 补了一条「继续」（带 attempt、kind、code） |
| `turn-swallowed` | 发现「假完成」（带 why：`dsml-leak` / `echo-reasoning` / `no-output`） |
| `continue-skipped` | 判断过但没补（带 why：`user-abort` / `policy` / `stall-already-handled`） |
| `continue-deferred` | 本来要补，但你在输入或已经跑起来了（`user-took-over` / `inbox-busy`） |
| `continue-budget-exhausted` | 预算用完，需要人看一眼 |
| `stall-detected` | 判定假死（带 silenceMs） |
| `clock-jump` | 机器睡眠/事件循环被卡，这一轮巡检只搬时间锚点、不判定（带 gapMs） |
| `question-asked` / `approval-asked` | 记录了你被卡住 |
| `question-blocked` / `approval-blocked` | 卡太久，提醒你 |
| `request-retry` | 重试了一次模型请求（默认关闭） |

debug 级的记录（比如每轮一条 `running`）默认不落盘，只有 `verbose: true` 才写，免得把上面这些有用的记录淹掉。

---

## 调参

默认值够用。想改就把示例配置复制过去，改完重启 dsh：

```powershell
Copy-Item .\unstuck.config.example.json "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\unstuck\config.json"
```

优先级：内置默认 < profile 里 `cordis.patch.yml` 的 config < 这个 `config.json`（后者赢）。

| 键 | 默认 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关，关掉后一个监听器都不装 |
| `autoContinue` | `true` | 续跑总开关 |
| `continueMax` | `3` | 每个会话最多自动续几次 |
| `continueText` | `"继续"` | 续跑发什么 |
| `continueOnSwallowed` | `true` | 「假完成」也续跑，见「断连根因」一节 |
| `continueTextSwallowed` | 带指向性的一句 | 「假完成」时发的措辞 |
| `continueDelayMs` | `700` | 发现中断后先等多久 |
| `backoffMs` | `[1500,5000,15000]` | 每次续跑额外等待 |
| `continueOn` | 异常类原因 | 只在这些 turn 结束原因上续跑 |
| `skipCodes` | 认证类错误码 | 命中就不续（试也没用） |
| `autoRetry` | `false` | 模型请求层重试，**默认关**，见下 |
| `retryMax` | `2` | 请求重试次数 |
| `stallEnabled` | `true` | 假死检测开关 |
| `stallMs` | `180000` | 请求发出后多久没流片段算假死（3 分钟） |
| `stallResumeMs` | `800` | 掐掉后等多久再补「继续」 |
| `tickMs` | `15000` | 巡检间隔 |
| `hardStallMs` | `0` | 整轮零事件的兜底阈值，0=关闭（长工具本来就很久没事件） |
| `notifyBlocked` | `true` | 卡审批/等回答时提醒 |
| `blockedNotifyMs` | `120000` | 卡多久开始提醒 |
| `notifyCommand` | `""` | 额外执行的命令，`{msg}` 会替换成正文；留空只写日志 |
| `skipOwnedAgents` | `true` | 子 agent 不插手 |
| `verbose` | `false` | 连 debug 级也打印到控制台 |

### 和 dsh 自带「继续」按钮的关系

桌面端本来就有一个「继续」按钮（`POST /api/tauri/ui/session/resume`），它做的事和本插件一样：判断上一轮是不是正常结束，不是就补一条 `Continue the interrupted task...`。

区别在于**它是手动的**——得你去点。本插件把那套判断搬进进程内、按事件自动触发，而且更保守：

- 你按了停止 → 不续
- 认证失败 / 余额不足 / 上下文超长 → 不续（点了也没用）
- 连续中断超过 `continueMax` 次 → 停手并提醒
- 你的消息一进来 → 立刻让位

它发的消息 source.kind 是 `dsh-unstuck`，跟桌面端按钮的 `continue` 区分开，日志里一眼能看出是谁干的。反过来，如果发现会话里已经有一条 `continue` 或 `dsh-unstuck` 消息，本插件不会再补第二条。

### 和 dsh-purge 的关系

dsh-purge 自带一个 `autoRetry`（profile 里默认**开着**），做的是同一件事。所以本插件 `autoRetry` 默认 `false`，避免两边叠成 6 次重试。

想让监督员统一管：在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里把 dsh-purge 的 `autoRetry` 设成 `false`，再把本插件的 `autoRetry` 设成 `true`。

---

## 桌面通知（可选）

Windows 上想收气泡提醒，把 `notifyCommand` 设成：

```json
{ "notifyCommand": "msg * {msg}" }
```

或者用 [BurntToast](https://github.com/Windos/BurntToast)：`pwsh -NoProfile -c "New-BurntToastNotification -Text 'dsh', '{msg}'"`。

---

## 它做不到的事

- **dsh 进程整个没了（崩溃、被关掉、桌面端退出）** —— 插件在进程内，进程死了它也跟着死，救不了。这种要靠外部守护进程，不在本插件范围。
- **模型一直返回同样错误** —— 预算用完后它只提醒，不硬刚。
- **它不替你回答提问、不替你点审批。** 这是故意的：那类决定不该自动化。

---

## 开发

```powershell
cd <仓库根目录>
node --test "test/*.test.js"
```

- `lib/core.js` 纯逻辑（判原因、算退避、造消息、读 session 事件），无副作用，好测
- `lib/config.js` 默认值 + 归一化 + 用户配置文件
- `lib/index.js` cordis 装配层，只管接事件和发消息
- `test/core.test.js` 逻辑单测；`test/plugin.test.js` 用假 ctx / 假 agent 跑装配层

改完 `lib/` 想让它生效，有两条路（实测过，别信「改 profile patch 就能热重载」这种说法，那个不成立）：

1. **改已安装目录里的文件** —— dsh 在监听 `~/.dsh/plugins/` 下的插件目录，文件一变，1~2 秒内自己 `dispose` + `boot`，不用重启。所以先同步：
   ```powershell
   Copy-Item .\lib\*.js $env:DSH_HOME\plugins\dsh-unstuck\lib\ -Force
   ```
   然后看 `~/.dsh/unstuck/unstuck.jsonl` 尾部有没有新的 `boot` 行。
2.

plugins.description: DSH 插件：右下角一只罐子，按兴趣轴定向挑 B站 视频。互动率打分，不靠推荐流。
plugins.readme_text:
# 电子榨菜罐 · dsh-bili-jar

> DSH 插件：右下角一只罐子，替你挑「今天看哪几条」B 站视频。

不靠 B 站 的推荐流。它按你自己写的一组**兴趣轴**去搜，用**互动率**（赞 / 币 / 藏）而不是播放量排好坏，把结果攒进一个**累积池**，点开就能看。

## 现在能做什么

- **按轴定向搜索**：轴 = 一组词（`deepseek` / `时政` / `科技测评` / `健身教程`），视频的 tag 贴近任意一根就入池
- **硬过滤**：时长 ≥ 8 分钟、播放量门槛、充电专属不推、直播回放不推
- **互动率打分**：点赞率 / 投币率 / 收藏率 / 弹幕率，加新鲜度、字幕、多轴覆盖
- **💎 宝藏标记**：收藏率和投币率同时进候选池前 20%
- **累积池**：今天没搜到的好东西，明天被别的关键词带出来也不会丢
- **换一批**：排除上一批，真的换而不是重排
- **稍后看**：本地存一份待看清单
- 罐子可拖动，位置记在本地

## 界面

右下角一只玻璃罐，点开是面板：`推荐 / 关注 / 待看` 三个页签，滚到底有「换一批」。

## 安装

⚠️ 桌面版 DSH 的 `desktop` profile 不允许用 CLI 装插件（`profile "desktop" is managed exclusively by the Electron application`）。当前只能手工装：

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop/package.json
{
  "dependencies": { "dsh-bili-jar": "link:D:/你的路径/电子榨菜罐" },
  "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": ["@deepseek-ai/dsh-base", "dsh-bili-jar"] } }
}
```

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/desktop && pnpm install
```

装完**必须重启 DSH**（bundle 层要重新组装）。

## 结构

| 文件 | 干什么 |
|---|---|
| `index.js` | host 半端：配置、`/api/bili-jar/{ping,state,feed,debug}` 路由、累积池落盘 |
| `client.js` | 浏览器半端：罐子 + 面板（`__ModuleLoader__` 自注册） |
| `lib/bili.mjs` | B站 客户端：WBI 签名 / 搜索 / 详情 / 粉丝 / 投稿 / tag |
| `lib/pool.mjs` | 候选池：轴匹配、硬过滤、打分、按轴轮转出片单 |
| `lib/hostdeps.mjs` | 从宿主树里取 `@deepseek-ai/schemastery`（含桌面版 `app.asar` 路径） |
| `docs/` | 设计记录：接口实测、tag 树算法 |

## 工具

```bash
node tools/why.mjs BV1xxxxx        # 这条为什么没进罐子？逐关诊断
node tools/feed.mjs 10000 0        # 跑一次建池，打印片单
node tools/probe.mjs deepseek      # 勘探接口字段
node tools/crawl-tags.mjs 4        # 抓 tag 语料
node tools/tag-tree.mjs            # 从语料里聚类出 tag 树
```

## 已知限制

- 时政区大量视频**没有 tag**，只能靠标题里的实体词判定
- 「时政」这个词在 B 站 被考公党占领，真·国际时政要用实体词搜（见 `docs/tag-tree.md`）
- 粉丝数按 UP 查、没法批量，只对进决赛圈的候选查
- LLM 终审（判营销号）还没做

## 许可

MIT

plugins.description: Zero-token scheduled script runner for DeepSeek Harness (dsh-plugin): cron in the Host, no model calls, wake-on-change
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-noagent-schedule

**Run shell scripts on a schedule inside DeepSeek Harness — with no model call and no token cost.**

Every scheduling plugin in the DSH ecosystem delivers a message to a session or starts a new one,
so a cron tick always means a model wake-up. This plugin takes the other path: the Host runs the
command itself, the way `systemd` or `launchd` would. The model is only involved when you actually
want it to be — see [wake on change](#wake-on-change).

[简体中文](README.zh.md)

## What it gives you

| | |
|---|---|
| **Zero token** | A tick that runs a script costs nothing. The plugin never touches the LLM services. |
| **Cron or interval** | Five-field Vixie cron (`*/15 9-17 * * 1-5`, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`) or `everySeconds`. |
| **Explicit time zones** | IANA zones per job, so the schedule means what it says regardless of where the Host runs. |
| **Logs you can read** | One file per run with argv, exit code, stdout and stderr; a `runs.jsonl` ledger beside it. |
| **Overlap protection** | A job whose previous run is still going is skipped, not stacked. |
| **Timeout** | Oversized jobs are terminated at `timeoutSeconds`. |
| **Qinglong-style task page** | Overview cards, search and status filter, one row per job with a status dot, a human-readable schedule ("daily 18:30" instead of `30 18 * * *`), last and next run, a strip of the last 8 results, and a log drawer. |
| **Edit from the page** | Enable or disable a job, change its cron or interval, timeout, name or command, and delete it. Every write is validated, backed up, and re-parsed before it lands, so `jobs.json` can never be left unloadable. |
| **Agent tools** | `noagent_status`, `noagent_run`, `noagent_log`, `noagent_update` — the same operations the UI uses. |
| **Wake on change** | Turn a polling script into an event source: the model is woken only when its output changes. |

## Install

### From the plugin market (Discover)

Open **Plugins > Discover > Manage index sources** and add:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule/main/index.json
```

The bundle then appears in the Discover list with its description and icon, and installs like any other entry. (The Discover tab needs the experimental plugin-market bundle enabled.)

### From a checkout

```
git clone https://github.com/monkey-sking/dsh-noagent-schedule.git
plugin_manager({ action: "install_bundle", target: "<cloned directory>" })
```

Or point `target` at a checkout of this repository.

Nothing is scheduled until you write a job file.

## Where things live

| | Default | Configure |
|---|---|---|
| Job list | `~/.dsh/noagent/jobs.json` | `jobsFile` |
| State and logs | `~/.dsh/noagent/state/` | `stateDir` |

The job file is re-read every 10 seconds, so adding, editing or disabling a job needs no restart.

```
state/
├── state.json              # per job: last start, exit code, duration, fingerprint
├── runs.jsonl              # one line per run
└── runs/<job-id>/<ts>.log  # full stdout/stderr of that run
```

## Jobs

```json
{
  "jobs": [
    {
      "id": "nightly-backup",
      "name": "Nightly backup",
      "enabled": true,
      "cron": "0 3 * * *",
      "timeZone": "Asia/Shanghai",
      "cwd": "/srv/app",
      "command": "bash scripts/backup.sh",
      "timeoutSeconds": 600
    }
  ]
}
```

| Field | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `id` | Unique, also the log directory name. Required. |
| `cron` | Five fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week. Supports `*/n`, `a-b`, `a-b/n`, lists, `sun..sat`, `jan..dec`. |
| `everySeconds` | Fixed interval, minimum 30. Use instead of `cron`. |
| `timeZone` | IANA zone. Defaults to the plugin's `defaultTimeZone`. |
| `cwd` | Working directory. Defaults to the user's home. |
| `command` | Run through `/bin/bash -lc`. Alternatively use `argv` for an exact process. |
| `argv` | Array form; no shell involved. |
| `env` | Extra environment variables, merged over the inherited environment. |
| `timeoutSeconds` | Terminate after this long. Default 300. |
| `enabled` | `false` keeps the job in the file but does not schedule it. |
| `wakeOnChange` | See below. |

### Why `bash -lc`

A GUI-launched Host inherits a minimal `PATH` — often just `/usr/bin:/bin`. A login shell picks up
the user's profile, so `git`, `node`, `python3` and friends resolve the way they do in a terminal.
Homebrew's standard prefixes are prepended as a fallback.

If you would rather not depend on shell startup files, use `argv` with absolute paths.

## Wake on change

A polling script usually answers one question: *did anything change?* Running it on a timer is
free; waking a model to ask the same question every few minutes is not.

`wakeOnChange` separates the two:

```json
{
  "id": "inbox-watch",
  "everySeconds": 120,
  "command": "bash scripts/probe-inbox.sh",
  "wakeOnChange": {
    "sessionId": "session-…",
    "title": "New mail",
    "prompt": "The probe found something new:\n\n{{output}}\n\nHandle it per the usual routine; reply [SILENT] if nothing needs doing.",
    "ignoreLines": ["^ts=", "progress: \\d+%"]
  }
}
```

How it behaves:

- The probe runs every 120 seconds. **No change means no model call at all.**
- Output is normalised (lines matching `ignoreLines` are dropped), then fingerprinted.
- A changed fingerprint schedules a one-shot delivery to `sessionId` about a second later, carrying
  the probe output through `{{output}}`.
- The first run only records a baseline, so installing the plugin does not immediately wake anyone.
  Set `notifyOnFirstRun: true` to opt in.
- A non-zero exit is never treated as "something changed" — failures show up in the log and the
  status, not as false wakes.
- Every wake is a one-shot scheduled delivery, and one-shot rows stay in the Host's task table
  after delivery. The plugin deletes each wake row once it has been delivered (the previous row is
  removed before the next wake, delivered rows are swept every 30 seconds, and leftovers from an
  earlier version are cleaned on the first tick), so "automation tasks" keeps listing only the real
  recurring jobs instead of a wall of identical one-shot entries.
- Empty output means nothing to report.
- `onlyOnNew` can be narrowed with `keyPattern`: only the matched part of each line identifies an
  entry, so a conversation whose last message changes (including our own reply) is not "new"; only a
  genuinely new conversation wakes the session. Lines unmatched by the pattern fall back to the
  whole line.

Placeholders in `prompt` and `title`: `{{job}}` (name), `{{id}}` (id), `{{output}}` (truncated to
4000 characters).

The target session receives an ordinary scheduled message, so anything that already works with a
scheduled delivery works here.

## UI

- **Settings → No-Agent Schedule** — one page listing every job.
- **Sidebar → clock icon** — the same list as a panel.

Both show the schedule, time zone, command, last run (time, exit code, duration), a *Run now*
button and a *Show last log* toggle. The panel refreshes every five seconds while open.

## Agent tools

| Tool | Does |
|---|---|
| `noagent_status` | List jobs with their last run. Pass `id` for one job. |
| `noagent_run` | Run one job immediately, outside its schedule. |
| `noagent_log` | Read the tail of a job's most recent log. |

The UI and the tools call the same Host implementation.

## Limits

- **Runs only while DSH is running.** A tick missed because the Host was closed is not caught up on
  restart. For a watchdog that must survive the app being closed, use `launchd`, `systemd` or
  `cron` instead — that is what they are for.
- **Not a sandbox.** Jobs run with the Host's own permissions. Treat the job file as executable
  configuration.
- **macOS may still refuse access.** A Host process inherits the app's TCC grants; a job touching a
  protected location can fail where a terminal would succeed, and vice versa. Read the log rather
  than assuming.

## Licence

MIT.

plugins.description: DSH 插件：任务完成 / 审批请求 / DSH 提问时用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你——只有你不在看 DSH 时才打扰
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-remind

**任务做完了 / DSH 需要你批准或回答，但你在看别的窗口 —— 用 Windows 原生通知（带提示音）提醒你。**

DSH 的会话跑完不会主动告诉你，切出去以后只能靠回来瞄一眼；DSH 等你批准或回答时更是干等着。这个插件把「这一轮真的做完了」和「DSH 需要你处理」都变成一条 Windows 通知，而且**只在你不在看 DSH 的时候**才打扰。

---

## 它做什么

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 完成任务提醒 | 顶层会话的 agent 从 `running` 落回 `idle`（这一轮真的结束）；后台任务（jobs）落地时也会补一条 |
| 审批提醒 | DSH 请求批准时提醒。**只有真的在等你决定才提醒**：先等 800ms 确认窗口，期间被自动批准/拒绝/自动审批器决定掉就不打扰 |
| 提问提醒 | DSH 调用 `ask_user_question` 向你提问时提醒，通知里带问题原文（多个问题显示第一条 + 数量） |
| 提示音 | 三类通知都可配提示音（`default` / `reminder` / `alarm` / `im` / `mail` / `sms` / `call` … 或 `none` 静音）；默认任务完成用 `default`，审批/提问用更醒目的 `reminder` |
| 只在该提醒时提醒 | 用 Win32 `GetForegroundWindow` 读当前前台窗口的**标题与进程名**，命中 `focusMarkers`（默认 `DeepSeek Harness`）就认为你正在看 DSH，不弹通知（审批/提问可单独配置） |
| 通知形态 | Windows 原生 Toast（进操作中心、可关闭、可点击） |
| 通知内容 | 任务完成：`DSH · 任务完成` + 会话标题 · 工作区 · 用时；审批：`DSH · 需要批准` + 工具名 · 会话；提问：`DSH · 需要你的回答` + 问题文本 · 会话 |

### 防误报设计

一轮「结束」到真正「没事干了」之间可能还有后续动作，所以判定做了四层：

1. **只认顶层会话**：`ctx.agents.roots()` 排除子代理——子代理结束时父轮还在跑，不该打扰。
2. **静默期复查**（默认 700ms）：复查时仍须满足「agent 仍是 idle、inbox 没有排队的 `nextTurn`/`nextStep`、该会话没有 `running|stopping` 的 job、`workspace/session-activity` 里没有 `turn/job/subagent`」。任何一条不满足就放弃这次提醒。
3. **同会话冷却**（默认 5s）：避免 turn 结束与 job 落地撞在一起弹两条。
4. **宽限期**（默认 1500ms）：弹通知前先等 1.5 秒，你刚切回 DSH 就不打扰。

### 审批 / 提问提醒怎么判断「真的在等你」

- **审批**：订阅 `approval/asked` / `approval/decided` 审计对。注意 `approval/asked` 对**每一次**审批都会追加，包括策略为 `never`（直接拒绝）或自动审批器立即决定的情况——所以不是「一见到 asked 就弹」，而是先静默 `attentionSettleMs`（默认 800ms）：期间收到同 id 的 `approval/decided` 就当作没发生。
- **提问**：订阅 `tool/call`，且工具名是 `ask_user_question`。解析其参数 JSON 取问题文本；同样先静默 800ms，期间收到同 `callId` 的 `tool/result`（你已经答完或工具已返回）就取消。
- 子代理里发出的审批/提问会沿 `session.header.parentSession` 上溯，展示到顶层会话的标题上；`turn/end` 或会话销毁时清掉该会话所有待发提醒。

---

## 架构与关键取舍

```
src/index.js            宿主端 cordis 插件：订阅事件、注册 /api/dsh-remind.* 路由、拼通知
src/detect.js           「任务完成」判定（纯逻辑，可脱离 DSH 单测）
src/attention.js        「审批 / 提问」判定（确认窗口、去重、子代理上溯）
src/notify.js           Windows 通知层：调助手脚本、提示音归一化、解析结果
scripts/dsh-remind.ps1  单次 PowerShell 助手：宽限 → 前台判定 → WinRT Toast + 提示音（一次进程完成）
src/config.js           配置读写（原子写、BOM 容错、非法值夹紧）
src/contract.js         对 DSH 宿主接口的全部假设清单（升级体检用）
test/                   单测 + 真实通知实测
tools/                  侦察与验证工具（读 app.asar、带鉴权调路由、真实宿主端到端、doctor）
```

**为什么是 PowerShell，而不是 Electron 的 `Notification`？**
DSH 桌面端把宿主跑在**独立的 Node 进程**里（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-desktop-host`），插件拿不到 Electron API；DSH 自身也没有对插件开放的 OS 级通知接口（整个壳里只有更新提示那一处 `Notification`）。所以走系统自带能力：Windows PowerShell 5.1 的 WinRT Toast API。整轮（含前台判定）实测约 **300ms**，任务完成这种低频事件完全够用。

**为什么不用 koffi FFI 直接调 user32？**
koffi 的原生 `.node` 在 DSH 安装目录里有两套（3.1.1 / 3.3.2，互不兼容），且只能按绝对路径加载；插件里引它会把「DSH 升级 / 换机器」变成故障源。PowerShell 是每台 Windows 都有的稳定面。

**前台判定为什么看窗口标题而不是页面可见性？**
GUI 可能在 Electron 窗口里，也可能在浏览器标签页里（比如 Edge 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:19387`）。两种情况的活动窗口标题都来自页面 `<title>DeepSeek Harness</title>`，所以标题匹配同时覆盖两种形态；浏览器里切到别的标签页时，窗口标题变成那个标签页的标题，于是正确判定为「不在看 DSH」。

---

## 安装

本机**已安装并已生效**（desktop profile）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add <克隆下来的仓库目录>
```

这一步会：把包以 `link:` 形式加进 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\package.json` 的 dependencies，并把 `dsh-remind` 追加到 `dsh.profile.bundles`。插件的 `cordis.patch.yml` 负责把自己挂进 profile 组合树：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-remind
      name: dsh-remind
```

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile desktop remove dsh-remind`，或在 GUI 的 Plugins 页里移除。

> **改完插件源码要重启 DSH 才生效**：插件以 `link:` 方式安装，profile 热重载会重新执行 `apply()`，但 Node 的 ESM 模块缓存不会失效——已加载过的模块仍是旧代码。实测：改动 `src/` 后触发 profile 重载，日志里出现的仍是旧版 `ready` 行；重启桌面端后才是新代码。纯配置改动（`config.json` 或 `setConfig` 路由）不受影响。

---

## 配置

配置文件：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\plugins\dsh-remind\config.json`（改完**重启 DSH** 生效；也可以用下面的 `setConfig` 路由热改）。

| 字段 | 默认 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `enabled` | `true` | 总开关 |
| `onlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | 只在「前台不是 DSH」时提醒；`false` = 每次都提醒 |
| `focusMarkers` | `["DeepSeek Harness"]` | 命中即视为「正在看 DSH」的窗口标题/进程名片段（子串匹配） |
| `graceMs` | `1500` | 弹通知前的宽限期：你马上切回来就不打扰 |
| `settleMs` | `700` | 判定「真的做完了」前的静默期 |
| `minRunMs` | `0` | 短于此时长的任务不提醒（0 = 不限制） |
| `cooldownMs` | `5000` | 同一会话两次提醒的最小间隔 |
| `notifyOnJob` | `true` | 后台任务全部落地时也提醒 |
| `title` | `DSH · 任务完成` | 通知标题 |
| `bodyTemplate` | `{{session}} · {{workspace}} · 用时 {{duration}}` | 正文模板，支持 `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` `{{duration}}` `{{cause}}`；空片段连同分隔符自动省略 |
| `sound` | `default` | 任务完成通知的提示音：`default` / `im` / `mail` / `reminder` / `sms` / `alarm` / `alarm2`…`alarm10` / `call` / `call2`…`call10` / `loop` / `none` |
| `notifyOnApproval` | `true` | DSH 请求批准时提醒 |
| `notifyOnQuestion` | `true` | DSH 向你提问时提醒 |
| `attentionOnlyWhenUnfocused` | `true` | 审批/提问是否也遵守前台判定（`false` = 正在看 DSH 也弹） |
| `attentionGraceMs` | `300` | 审批/提问通知的宽限期（比任务完成更短） |
| `attentionSettleMs` | `800` | 审批/提问的确认窗口：期间被决定/回答就不打扰 |
| `approvalTitle` | `DSH · 需要批准` | 审批提醒标题 |
| `approvalBodyTemplate` | `{{tool}} · {{session}}` | 审批正文模板，支持 `{{tool}}` `{{reason}}` `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` |
| `questionTitle` | `DSH · 需要你的回答` | 提问提醒标题 |
| `questionBodyTemplate` | `{{question}} · {{session}}` | 提问正文模板，支持 `{{question}}` `{{session}}` `{{workspace}}` |
| `attentionSound` | `reminder` | 审批/提问提醒的提示音 |
| `openOnClick` | `false` | 开启后通知可点击，用默认浏览器打开带令牌的 DSH 地址 |
| `actionLabel` | `打开 DSH` | 可点击时的按钮文案 |
| `aumid` | `""` | Toast 的 AUMID；留空用系统 PowerShell 已注册的那个 |
| `debug` | `false` | 把每次判定写进 `events.jsonl`，排查「为什么没提醒」时打开 |

---

## 自检与排查

**1) 立刻弹一条测试通知** —— 在 DSH 页面（浏览器/桌面窗口均可）按 F12 打开控制台执行：

```js
// 任务完成样式
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' })
  .then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
// 审批 / 提问样式（带 reminder 提示音）
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'approval' }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.test', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ kind: 'question', sound: 'alarm' }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

**2) 看当前状态、前台判定与最近判定**：

```js
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.status', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' }, body: '{}' })
  .then(r => r.json()).then(x => console.log(x.result))
```

返回里的 `foreground` 就是「现在算不算在看 DSH」的判定依据（窗口标题、进程名、是否命中）；`recent` 是最近若干次任务完成判定（`notified` / `focused` / `queued-work` / `jobs-running` / `session-active` / `cooldown` …）；`attention.recent` 是审批/提问判定，`attention.pending` 是还在确认窗口里的条数。

**3) 热改配置**（不重启）：

```js
fetch('/api/dsh-remind.setConfig', { method: 'POST', headers: { 'content-type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ onlyWhenUnfocused: false, debug: true }) }).then(r => r.json()).then(console.log)
```

**4) 判定轨迹**：`debug: true` 时，`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\plugins\dsh-remind\events.jsonl` 会记录加载与每次判定。

**5) 命令行测试**：

```powershell
node --test                                        # 单测（判定逻辑、配置、路由装配）
$env:DSH_REMIND_E2E='1'; node --test test/notify.test.mjs   # 真实弹一条 Windows 通知
```

---

## 验证记录（本机实测）

| 项目 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| 前台窗口探测 | ✅ 正确读出前台窗口标题与进程名，耗时 ~250ms |
| 原生 Toast（中文 + emoji） | ✅ 弹出并进入操作中心历史（`History.GetHistory` 可查） |
| 提示音 | ✅ Toast XML 带 `<audio src="ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Reminder" loop="false"/>`，实测可闻 |
| 通知层实测 | ✅ `node --test` 全部通过（含前台命中时正确跳过、提示音参数） |
| 真实宿主加载 | ✅ desktop（DSH 0.2.1-rc.2）宿主启动即加载，`events.jsonl` 记录 `ready: … approval=true question=true sound=default/reminder` |
| 真实任务端到端 | ✅ 临时 profile 跑一轮真实任务：`status running → status idle → notified`，并真实弹出通知 |
| **真实提问端到端** | ✅ 临时 web profile 里让 agent 真的调用 `ask_user_question` → 插件 `attention.recent` 记录 `kind=question, action=notify`，通知里带问题原文与 `reminder` 提示音 |
| 审批/提问通知样式 | ✅ `/api/dsh-remind.test` 的 `kind=approval|question` 在真实宿主里弹窗、提示音正确（`ms-winsoundevent:Notification.Reminder`） |
| 插件路由 | ✅ `/api/dsh-remind.{status,config,setConfig,probe,test}` 在真实宿主里可用（信封与裸 JSON 两种请求体都支持） |
| 升级稳定性 | ✅ 零依赖 + 零 `peerDependencies`，不会被 DSH 的版本兼容校验拦下（`evaluatePluginCompatibility` 无 peer 直接放行）；bundle 解析失败只会「跳过 + stderr 一行」，不会导致 profile 启动失败 |
| 契约体检 | ✅ `node tools/doctor.mjs` 五层全 PASS：20 条公开契约对着**新版本 DSH 自带 API 目录**逐条核对通过，另有 2 条实现核对（审批/提问事件名、提问工具名）通过 |

---

## DSH 升级后的稳定性

**结论：升级不会把插件卸载或禁用，真正的风险是宿主接口漂移；后者已用「契约清单 + 体检脚本」兜住。**

### 升级不会动它（已核对 DSH 自身源码）

| 事实 | 依据 |
|---|---|
| 插件代码在本地克隆目录里，不在 DSH 程序目录里；升

# dsh-chat-search

English | [简体中文](README.zh.md)

Chat search and context highlighting plugin for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). Supports global cross-session search across all tasks and precise in-chat keyword searching.

## ✨ Features

- 🌐 **Global Cross-Session Search**:
  - Scan all task sessions and history across multiple workspaces;
  - Context extraction with keyword match snippets;
  - Group and collapse matches by session, showing roles (user/assistant), turn indices, and timestamps;
  - Click to switch sessions automatically with smooth scrolling and glow highlight animations.

- 💬 **In-Chat Search**:
  - Search within the current active session in real-time;
  - Navigate previous/next matches with keyboard shortcuts.

- 🎯 **Context Highlighting & Instant Navigation**:
  - Multi-tier DOM anchor resolution (`data-chat-anchor-key` / `data-chat-node-key` / `data-chat-turn`);
  - Smooth viewport scrolling + 2.5s pulsing outline glow (`dsh_cs_flash`) to pinpoint target messages immediately.

- ⌨️ **Keyboard Shortcuts**:
  - `Ctrl + Shift + F` / `Alt + F`: Open global search panel;
  - `Ctrl + F`: Open in-chat search;
  - `Enter` / `Shift + Enter`: Next / previous match in current chat;
  - `Esc`: Close search panel.

- 🎨 **Native Theme Integration**:
  - Built with DSH theme CSS variables, seamlessly matching dark and light modes;
  - Sleek glassmorphism floating action button (🔍) in the bottom-right corner.

## 📦 Installation

Install via DSH CLI:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add helo060228/dsh-chat-search
```

Or search for `dsh-chat-search` directly inside the DSH Plugin Market.

## 📄 License

plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-open-any

给 **DeepSeek Harness**（DSH）的对话界面加「文件右键 → 打开方式」：对话里出现的文件，右键就能用本机任意应用打开。

![license](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-green)
![platform](https://img.shields.io/badge/platform-Windows%20%7C%20macOS%20%7C%20Linux-blue)
![dsh](https://img.shields.io/badge/DSH-0.2.0--rc.2%20verified-orange)

```
              ┌──────────────────────────────┐
   右键 a.ts  │ a.ts                         │
      ──────▶ │ 用 VS Code 打开              │
              │ 在文件资源管理器中打开        │  ← 一级菜单，不用展开
              │ 打开方式              ▸      │──▶ VS Code / Cursor / Windows Terminal
              │ ─────────────────────────    │
              │ 其他应用…（系统对话框）      │  ← 本插件独有：可选出未注册关联的应用
              │ ─────────────────────────    │
              │ 复制路径                     │
              └──────────────────────────────┘
```

## 它能做什么

| 菜单项 | 行为 |
|---|---|
| **用 <默认应用> 打开** | 用系统默认关联程序打开文件 |
| **在文件资源管理器中打开** | 一级菜单项；在文件管理器中定位该文件（Windows 用此措辞，macOS 为「在访达中显示」） |
| **打开方式 ▸** | 列出本机为该文件类型注册过关联的编辑器 / 终端（带真实图标与「（默认）」标记） |
| **其他应用…（系统对话框）** | 唤起 Windows 原生「打开方式」对话框，可选**未注册文件关联**的应用（例如 Visual Studio） |
| **复制路径** | 复制绝对路径 |

识别范围：

| 元素 | DOM 特征 | 路径来源 |
|---|---|---|
| Markdown 文件链接 | `button.fileLink` | `title` 属性 |
| 输入框 / 消息里的 `@文件` 引用 | `[data-ref-chip="file"]` | `title`（`@路径`） |
| 路径标签（PathLabel） | `[data-path-label]` | `title` |
| 其它带 `title` 的元素（兜底） | 任意祖先的 `title` | `title`，仅当它「看着就是路径」时命中 |

相对路径会按**当前正在查看的会话**的工作目录补全成绝对路径（Host 侧只用进程 cwd 解析相对路径，所以必须在浏览器侧补全）。非文件位置右键仍弹浏览器原生菜单。

## 与同类插件的区别（诚实说明）

DSH 插件市场里已有几个同类插件（[dsh-file-link-menu](https://github.com/XcodeFish/dsh-file-link-menu)、[dsh-right-click-menu](https://github.com/AL1ghtm3ter/dsh-right-click-menu)、[dsh-file-menu](https://github.com/dreammaker2016/dsh-file-menu) 等），本插件**不是能力最全的那个**。它只主张两件事：

1. **「其他应用…（系统对话框）」**：走 `rundll32 shell32.dll,OpenAs_RunDLL`，能选**没有注册文件类型关联**的应用。只列 `workspacePathApplications` 的插件永远够不到这类程序（例如 Visual Studio 不在 DSH 的应用目录里时）。
2. **不拖垮启动的工程约束**：client 插件在 `apply` 阶段绝不抛异常、绝不等待服务就绪，factory 外层还有一个永不抛错的兜底 `apply`。DSH 的 web boot 把任何非 `active` 的条目当**致命错误**（`web boot: N entry did not activate`），实测会让整个 GUI 打不开——本插件为此付出的是「服务全部延迟到事件发生时惰性解析」的设计。

如果你需要超链接右键、另存为、复制文件内容、文件树右键等能力，请直接用上表里更全的插件，不要重复造这个轮子。

## 安装

### 从 GitHub 安装（推荐）

在 DSH 的「设置 → 插件」或插件管理器的添加框里填：

```
github:xl0223/dsh-open-any
```

或用 DSH 自带 CLI（把 `<profile>` 换成你的 profile 名，例如 `desktop`）：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add github:xl0223/dsh-open-any
```

装完**重启 DSH**：client bundle 按文件 mtime 生成 rev 并版本化缓存，不重启不会重载。

### 本地源码调试

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add link:C:\path\to\dsh-open-any
```

改完 `src/` 必须重新 `node scripts/build.mjs`（DSH 加载的是 `lib/`）；改 `lib/client.js` 刷新页面即可，改 host 半侧要重启。

### 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile <profile> remove dsh-open-any
```

或手工从 profile 的 `package.json` 里删掉 `dsh.profile.bundles` 与 `dependencies` 中的 `dsh-open-any`，重启。

## 兼容性

| 项 | 状态 |
|---|---|
| DSH 版本 | **0.2.0-rc.2 上完成真机验证**（菜单、应用列表、打开、文案） |
| DSH 0.2.1-rc.2 | 已静态确认：外壳冻结的模块基座表里仍有 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`（它被打包进外壳，不再有独立包目录）；**未做真机重验** |
| 平台 | Host 侧用 `rundll32` / `explorer` / `open` / `xdg-open`，三平台都有实现，但只在 Windows 11 上实测过 |
| Node | 构建需要 Node ≥ 20；运行时只用 DSH 自带能力 |

## 开发

```powershell
node scripts/build.mjs                                                  # 语法 + 契约校验 → lib/
node --test scripts/verify-client.test.mjs scripts/verify-host.test.mjs  # 离线单测
node tools/check-host-contract.mjs                                      # 与真实 app.asar 的模块/路由契约
node tools/probe-open-in-app.mjs                                        # 真机探测：本机会列出哪些应用
```

一条命令跑全部：`npm run check`。

## 验证报告（真实执行）

平台：Windows 11；DSH `D:\Ai_Agent\DeepSeek Harness`（0.2.0-rc.2 真机 / 0.2.1-rc.2 静态）。
以下命令与数字均为实际执行结果。

**1. 构建**

```
$ node scripts/build.mjs
built ...\lib\client.js  34339 bytes  sha256=f94b6dc6edee8545…
built ...\lib\index.js   15049 bytes  sha256=131c5ddbfd27fb3f…
```

**2. 离线单测：30 / 30 通过**

覆盖：路径识别与清理、会话 cwd 补全、菜单模型（加载中 / 有应用 / 失败）、平台措辞、Session Remote 请求体、host 路由回退、词典命中/未命中、host 路由的栅栏与方法/媒体类型边界、假 DOM 端到端（右键 → 菜单 → 选「用 Cursor 打开」→ 断言请求体）、以及一组**崩溃回归测试**（`apply` 在六种恶劣上下文下必须不抛错且完成挂载）。

```
ℹ tests 30  ℹ pass 30  ℹ fail 0
```

**3. 宿主契约（对真实 app.asar）**

```
$ node tools/check-host-contract.mjs
基座模块: react/jsx-runtime, react-dom, react-dom/client, @deepseek-ai/cordis,
          @tanstack/react-virtual, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-store,
          @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots, @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives,
          @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-dockkit, react, zod
契约检查通过：所有 require 与导出名都存在。
```

**4. 真机验证（0.2.0-rc.2）**

右键对话里的文件链接 → 菜单弹出 → 应用列表来自本机 → 选应用后文件被打开；「其他应用…（系统对话框）」唤起 Windows 原生选择器（用 `rundll32` 实测进程出现）。

## 已知限制

- **0.2.1-rc.2 未真机重验**：只确认了模块基座表，没有实际重启安装测试。
- 「其他应用…」仅 Windows 实现（`OpenAs_RunDLL`）；macOS / Linux 会返回 501。
- 图片类 Markdown 链接（有缩略图浮层、无 `title`）不命中。
- 只复制绝对路径，没有相对路径 / 文件名 / 文件内容 / 另存为。
- 不处理超链接、不处理文件树（侧边栏）内的右键。
- 未做 `canOpenWorkspacePath` 预检：文件不在工作区时，菜单仍会弹出、操作会失败并提示。

## 踩坑记录（给后来者）

1. **client 插件的 `apply` 绝不能抛异常，也不能等任何服务。**
   DSH 的 web boot 把非 `active` 条目当致命错误。静态 `inject` 会让 fiber 永远 `pending`；`apply` 里同步调 `ctx.effect(...)` + `locale.register(...)` 抛错则让 fiber `failed` —— 两者都会让整个 GUI 打不开（`crash-*-web-boot.log`: `web boot: 1 entry did not activate / <插件>: failed`）。正确姿势：factory 先挂一个 no-op `exports.apply`，真实实现包在 try 里；apply 只做 DOM/React，服务延迟到事件发生时惰性读取。
2. **`ctx.inject` 要一个一个注。** 把 `["slots","remote","sessions","locale"]` 一次性交给一个 `ctx.inject`，只要有一个名字对不上就**永远不回调**，整条链路静默失效且不报错。改成每个服务一条 `ctx.inject([name], cb)` 后立刻正常。
3. **`locale.bind(ns)(key)` 未命中时会原样返回 key。** 照单全收就会把 `open.default` 这种裸 key 显示到菜单里。必须判断 `返回值 !== key` 再采用，否则回退内置字典。
4. **GUI 页面的 origin 是 `dsh-app://app`**，不是 `http://127.0.0.1:<port>`。浏览器侧对相对路径的 `fetch` 不一定到得了 host 路由，排查时以 host 半侧写盘的证据为准。
5. **Host 侧路径必须先是绝对路径**（它用 `path.resolve` 按进程 cwd 解析），相对路径要在浏览器侧按会话 cwd 补全。

## 文件结构

```
dsh-open-any/
├── package.json          # bundle 清单：dsh.bundle.patch + dsh.client（platform: web）
├── cordis.patch.yml      # 组合层：插入 open-any 这一行
├── icon.svg              # 插件卡片图标
├── src/
│   ├── client.js         # 浏览器半侧：右键监听 + 菜单 + Session Remote / host 路由调用
│   └── host.js           # host 半侧：4 条带信任围栏的路由
├── lib/                  # 构建产物（DSH 实际加载，随仓库提交）
├── scripts/
│   ├── build.mjs         # 构建：语法 + 契约校验
│   ├── verify-client.test.mjs
│   └── verify-host.test.mjs
├── tools/
│   ├── check-host-contract.mjs   # 对真实 app.asar 校验模块与导出名
│   └── probe-open-in-app.mjs     # 真机探测本机应用目录
├── README.md / PROGRESS.md / AGENTS.md
└── LICENSE (MIT)
```

**Host 侧路由**（全部先过 `connection.requestRejection` 信任栅栏，再校验方法、媒体类型、64 KiB 请求体上限与路径存在性）：

| 路由 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `POST /dsh-open-any/open-as` | 唤起系统「打开方式」对话框 |
| `POST /dsh-open-any/open-file` | 用系统默认应用打开（Session Remote 不可用时的后备） |
| `POST /dsh-open-any/reveal` | 在文件管理器中定位 |
| `POST /dsh-open-any/diag` | 诊断上报落盘（`%TEMP%\dsh-open-any-diag.log`） |

plugins.description: wraps microsoft/playwright-cli
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-playwright-cli

[![npm](https://img.shields.io/npm/v/dsh-playwright-cli)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-playwright-cli)
[![license](https://img.shields.io/npm/l/dsh-playwright-cli)](LICENSE)

Drive a real browser from **DeepSeek Harness**: one tool, `playwright_cli`, wraps
[`microsoft/playwright-cli`](https://github.com/microsoft/playwright-cli), plus a bundled
`playwright-cli` skill that teaches the model the command vocabulary.

playwright-cli itself recommends *CLI + skills* over MCP for coding agents: commands are short, and
the page snapshot goes to a file instead of a giant tool schema or accessibility tree. This plugin
keeps that design and only adds the two missing pieces — a tool the model can call, and a skill that
is discovered and loaded on demand.

中文说明见 [README.zh.md](README.zh.md)。

## Install

**In the app:** **Plugins → Plugin Manager → install bundle → `dsh-playwright-cli`**.

**From a shell**, when the Harness CLI is on your PATH:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add dsh-playwright-cli
```

**From an agent:** `plugin_manager` with `action: install_bundle`, `target: dsh-playwright-cli`.

> PATH collisions are common on Windows (`dsh` may belong to another product). If `dsh plugin` is not
> the Harness CLI, use the in-app Plugin Manager.

`playwright-cli` must be available on the machine:

```bash
npm install -g @playwright/cli@latest
```

And a browser has to exist — playwright-cli ships none. Either download its Chromium once:

```bash
playwright-cli install-browser chrome-for-testing
```

or reuse a browser that is already installed, which needs no download at all:

```text
playwright_cli  open https://example.com --browser=msedge
```

## Quick start

```text
playwright_cli  open https://playwright.dev --browser=msedge
playwright_cli  snapshot --depth=4
   → [artifacts] C:\...\.playwright-cli\page-....yml   (read this file to get refs)
playwright_cli  click e15
playwright_cli  fill e7 "user@example.com"
playwright_cli  screenshot --filename=shot.png
playwright_cli  close
```

Every result carries the page status, the artifacts it produced (absolute paths), and the CLI's exit
code. `--raw` returns just the value, e.g. `--raw eval "document.title"`.

## Tool parameters

| Parameter | Required | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `command` | yes | One playwright-cli command without the `playwright-cli` prefix. Quote arguments containing spaces. |
| `session` | no | Named browser session (`-s=<name>`), for isolating parallel tasks. |
| `workdir` | no | Working directory; artifacts land in `<workdir>/.playwright-cli/`. Defaults to the session directory. |
| `timeoutMs` | no | Per-call wall clock limit (default from config, capped at 900000). |

## Configuration

Every field is optional and lives in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` under the `playwright-cli` row:

| Field | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `executable` | auto-discovered | Absolute path to `playwright-cli.js` (run with `nodePath`) or to a real executable |
| `nodePath` | `node` from PATH | Node used for the CLI *and* the browser daemon it spawns |
| `session` | none | Default session name |
| `timeoutMs` | `120000` | Per-command limit |
| `disableUpdateNotifier` | `true` | Sets `NO_UPDATE_NOTIFIER=1` (see the Node 24 note below) |
| `env` | `{}` | Extra environment, e.g. `PLAYWRIGHT_MCP_BROWSER: chrome` |

## How it works

- **No shell.** The command line is tokenized and passed as an argv vector to
  `node playwright-cli.js …`, so `&` in URLs, spaces in paths, `--data="k=v"` and Windows quoting
  cannot corrupt a command.
- **Discovery.** It walks up from the session directory looking for a local
  `node_modules/@playwright/cli` or `node_modules/playwright`, then checks the usual global npm,
  pnpm and Homebrew locations. `executable` overrides all of it.
- **Real Node, not the Host binary.** The desktop Host runs as Electron-as-node
  (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`), so `process.execPath` is the app binary. playwright-cli re-spawns its
  browser daemon with that path and dies with `too many arguments`; the plugin therefore resolves a
  real `node` from PATH first.
- **Exit codes are honest.** playwright-cli's update notifier crashes the process *after* a successful
  command on Node 24 (exit code becomes `0xC0000409`); the notifier is disabled by default.
- **Artifacts are files.** Snapshots, screenshots, PDFs, videos, traces and console logs are resolved
  to absolute paths and listed under `[artifacts]`, so the model reads them with `read` / `read_image`
  instead of paying for them in the result.
- **Hints, not guesses.** The two first-run failures (no browser installed, browser not started) get
  an extra `[hint]` line with the exact next command.

## Troubleshooting

| Symptom | Cause | Fix |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `playwright-cli is not installed or was not found` | no local/global install | `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`, or set `executable` |
| `Browser "chrome-for-testing" is not installed` | no bundled browser | `playwright_cli install-browser chrome-for-testing`, or `--browser=msedge` |
| `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found` | Chrome not in its default path | `--browser=msedge` or `--browser=chrome` |
| `too many arguments. Expected 1 argument but got 2` | CLI launched with the Electron binary | leave `nodePath` unset so the plugin resolves `node` |
| `The browser '<name>' is not open` | session idle-closed or never opened | `open` again (add `--persistent` to keep the profile) |
| `百度安全验证` page on Baidu | site-level anti-automation captcha | not a plugin bug: report the wall, try another engine |
| snapshot only has header/footer | results rendered after the command returned | re-run `snapshot`, or use `find "<text>"` |

## Maintaining this plugin

### Repository layout

| Path | Owns | Update it when |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `index.js` | Tool schema, spawn, discovery, artifacts, hints, presenters | CLI flags/output shape change, or DSH's `ToolDefinition` changes |
| `skill.js` | Model-facing skill text (command table, loop, triage) | the command surface changes |
| `cordis.patch.yml` | Loader row + default config + field comments | you add a config key |
| `locale/*.json`, `icon.svg` | Plugin Manager title, description, icon | wording/branding |
| `README.md`, `README.zh.md` | user + maintainer docs | any behavior change |

### Adapting to a new playwright-cli release

1. `npm view @playwright/cli version`, then `npm i -g @playwright/cli@latest`.
2. `playwright-cli --help` — compare the command list with the table in `skill.js`. The skill *is* the
   model's contract, so keep it in sync before anything else.
3. Check `open` / `attach` flags (`--browser`, `--device`, `--persistent`, `--profile`, `--config`).
   New flags normally need docs only, no code.
4. Check the output markers: `### Page`, `### Snapshot`, `[Snapshot](.playwright-cli/…)`, `### Events`
   with `console-….log#L1-L6`. If a path shape changes, adjust `MARKDOWN_LINK`, `FILE_TOKEN` and the
   `#L…` stripping in `collectArtifacts()`.
5. Check session selection: the plugin passes `-s=<name>` **and** sets `PLAYWRIGHT_CLI_SESSION`. If a
   release starts rejecting one of them, drop the env assignment in `execute()`.
6. Check the error strings matched by `hintFor()`: `is not installed`,
   `Chromium distribution 'chrome' is not found`, `is not open, please run open first`.
7. Run the smoke test below, then bump the version and the changelog.

### The output schema is enforced

DSH validates the tool's returned value against `output.schema`; a mismatch fails the whole call with
`returned invalid output`. Declare every nullable field as
`oneOf: [{type:'string'}, {type:'null'}]` (this bit us once with `signal: null`), and build the
returned object and the schema together.

### Adapting to a new DSH release

1. `dsh --version`; only raise `engines.dsh` when you depend on something new.
2. Re-check the four services the plugin uses. In a live session: `cordis_inspect_query` with
   `platform: host`, `provider: Service`, `input: {"service":"tools"}` (also `subprocess`, `skills`,
   `workingDirectory`).
3. Confirm `ctx.subprocess.resolveExecutable('node')` s

plugins.description: DeepSeek Harness plugin: explain Windows game crashes from Event Log, WER reports and crash dumps.
plugins.readme_text:
# game-crash-doctor

DeepSeek Harness 插件：游戏崩溃后，用 Windows 事件日志、WER 报告和转储文件告诉你**为什么崩**、**怎么修**。

> Windows only · DSH `0.1.2`+ · 所有分析都在本机完成，不联网、不上传数据。

## 功能

- **自动监控**：每 45 秒检查一次事件日志，发现新的游戏崩溃时在当前会话里推送一条通知（原因摘要 + 3 条建议）。
- **按需诊断**：随时调用 `diagnose_game_crash`，可指定回溯小时数和游戏名。
- **数据来源**：
  - 应用程序日志：Application Error 1000、Windows Error Reporting 1001、Application Hang 1002、.NET Runtime 1026
  - 系统日志：显示驱动 TDR 4101、Kernel-Power 41、BugCheck 1001、意外关机 6008
  - WER 报告 `Report.wer`（异常代码、故障模块、Bucket）
  - 崩溃转储：`%LOCALAPPDATA%\CrashDumps`、`C:\Windows\Minidump`、`C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports`
- **原因归类**：ACCESS_VIOLATION、C++/.NET 异常、堆破坏、栈溢出、显卡 TDR、DXGI 设备丢失、反作弊、蓝屏 BugCheck 等，并给出置信度和排查顺序。
- **重复崩溃识别**：同一程序/异常/模块在时间窗内反复出现时会单独提示。

## 安装

### 从 npm

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile desktop add game-crash-doctor
```

### 从本地源码

```powershell
# 1. 把本目录放到 profile 的 plugins 下
#    %USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\desktop\plugins\game-crash-doctor
# 2. 注册到 profile
dsh plugin --profile desktop add file:./plugins/game-crash-doctor
```

安装后重启 DSH（或在插件市场里点重启），工具和后台监控才会生效。

## 使用

直接对 Agent 说：

- “刚才游戏为什么崩了？”
- “帮我看看最近 3 天的崩溃记录”
- “只查 Wuthering Waves 的崩溃”

Agent 会调用 `diagnose_game_crash`：

| 参数 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `hours` | 回溯小时数，1–168，默认 24 |
| `game` | 只看可执行文件名/路径包含该关键词的记录 |

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给插件加 `config`：

```yaml
- id: game-crash-doctor
  name: game-crash-doctor
  config:
    notify: true              # 是否自动推送崩溃通知
    pollSeconds: 45           # 轮询间隔（15–600 秒）
    gameOnly: true            # 只对“像游戏”的崩溃推送
    notifyAllSessions: false  # true = 通知所有打开的会话
    maxNotificationsPerHour: 3
```

## 判断逻辑示例

| 信号 | 典型结论 |
|---|---|
| `0xC0000005` @ 游戏模块 | 模组/补丁越界、文件损坏、内存不稳 |
| `0xE06D7363` @ `KERNELBASE.dll` | 未捕获的 C++ 异常：游戏 bug、模组/汉化、反作弊注入 |
| `0xC0000374` / `0xC0000409` | 堆破坏 / 栈溢出：优先查内存超频、XMP、注入 DLL |
| `0x887A0006` 或 4101 TDR | 显卡驱动超时：DDU 重装驱动、恢复默认频率、查供电/温度 |
| Kernel-Power 41 | 异常断电/死机：电源、散热、超频、BIOS |
| BugCheck `0x124` | WHEA 硬件错误：CPU/内存/电源 |
| Application Hang 1002 | 主线程卡死：驱动、覆盖层、资源加载 |

## 隐私与安全

- 只读取本机 Windows 事件日志、WER 报告和转储文件，**不发起任何网络请求**。
- 不收集、不上传崩溃内容、路径或用户信息。
- 需要执行的唯一外部程序是系统自带的 `powershell.exe`（只读采集）。
- 事件日志查询不需要管理员权限；`C:\Windows\LiveKernelReports` 和部分 WER 目录可能需要管理员权限，读不到会自动跳过。

## 限制

- 仅支持 Windows 10/11。
- 不解析转储里的调用栈（没有符号表）；转储只用于定位和关联。需要更深的栈分析时，用 WinDbg 打开报告里给出的 `.dmp`。
- 如果游戏是“直接断电/死机”且系统来不及写日志，可能只能看到 Kernel-Power 41，插件会明确说明“没有应用崩溃记录”。
- 自动通知要求 DSH 正在运行；DSH 关闭期间发生的崩溃，会在下次启动后的第一次轮询补报。

## License

MIT
